Project Coordinator

jobs.description:
Full-Time

Fountain Valley, CA

Competitive Salary

Apply to hr@pacewater.com

#### **Description**

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, notices the details, anticipates what needs to happen next and enjoys helping a team stay organized. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between multiple projects and priorities and takes pride in producing polished, accurate work. You don’t need to know every PACE system on your first day—we value strong project coordination skills, initiative, professionalism and the ability to learn.

  

PACE is seeking a dynamic, highly organized individual with strong administrative skills to support administrative needs specifically for our Environmental Water Division. The admin group works as a team, so at times, is not limited to this one division. This candidate should be able to multi-task and have ability to switch to new projects accordingly. This position requires performing a variety of tasks, including, but not limited to the following:

**Requirements:**

* Coordinate the preparation, formatting, production and submittal of engineering reports, technical memoranda, specifications, proposals and other project deliverables.

* Prepare and format professional correspondence, proposals, change orders, purchase orders, sub-agreements, RFIs, work authorizations, meeting minutes, reports, tables and spreadsheets.

* Assist Project Managers with project schedules, tracking, monthly reports, invoicing and other project administration.

* Coordinate project documentation from project startup through completion, including electronic project files and correspondence.

* Assist with engineering specifications, including formatting and maintenance of specification libraries.

* Coordinate contracts and other project documentation to help ensure timely processing.

* Assist with project-related purchasing, shipping and vendor coordination.

* Prepare presentations and other project or marketing materials as needed.

* Coordinate meetings, calendars, travel arrangements and expense reports for Division Managers and senior staff.

* Attend meetings, prepare professional meeting minutes and track follow-up items.

* Maintain client and project information within company databases.

* Work collaboratively with PACE’s administrative, engineering and graphics teams.

* Provide additional project and administrative support as priorities arise.

* 3+ years of project coordination, project administration or administrative experience.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and changing priorities.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

* Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

* Professional judgment and ability to handle confidential information.

**Highly Preferred**

* + Experience within a civil engineering, environmental consulting, architecture, construction, or other A/E/C professional-services environment.
  + Experience supporting engineers, project managers or technical professionals.
  + Experience preparing technical reports, specifications, proposals or similar professional project documents.
  + Experience with Deltek, Ajera, Procore or comparable project management/ERP software.
  + Experience with Microsoft Project.

#### **Physical Demand**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands, handle or feel; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision; color vision is very helpful.

#### **Work Environment**

The noise level in the office work environment is moderate and typical of a professional office environment.

#### **Salary Range**

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and capabilities, $30–$38 per hour.

*PACE is an equal opportunity employer.*
  
*At this time, PACE will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.*
  
*Local candidates are preferred. No relocation package is offered.*

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator
jobs.description:

It is an important part of the culture that makes Chapman a special place to work and learn.

Collaborate with Graduate Director/Chair on semester course scheduling and assist with graduate student registration process and orientation

jobs.title: Distribution Hub Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Operations Coordinator**

**What We Do**

At Shef, we are bringing weekly personal chef services to busy families in a convenient and affordable format. We believe in providing amateur and professional chefs an opportunity to grow their own meal delivery businesses and make a meaningful income by doing what they love! Every person should have access to a wholesome, home-cooked meal at an affordable price.

We have raised nearly $90M from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, and M13, as well as founders and executives from Instacart, TaskRabbit, StubHub, AngelList, Lyft, Airbnb, and Yelp. We have a ton of exciting work ahead of us and are excited to have you join us!

**Role**

We are looking for an operationally-minded teammate to execute on the day-to-day on-the-ground operations. You will ensure deliveries safely make their way from chefs to consumers and serve as the face of Shef to chefs (“shefs”) in our markets. The ideal candidate is an excellent executor and communicator, and is passionate about bringing delicious, authentic food to their local market!

**Your Responsibilities**

* Ensure clean receipt of deliveries from shefs, and execute on sending deliveries off with third-party logistics providers
* Innovate, test, and measure success of operational efficiency initiatives - create SOPs for initiatives that prove positive enough to become a national standard and help roll-out such initiatives across the country
* Execute on national company standards, set forth by company leadership
* Provide educational and data-driven insights for chefs who visit the hub
* Serve as the face of Shef on the ground, particularly to chefs who drop off at the hub
* Manage hub-level inventory
* Utilize tools including ReTool, Slack, Google Sheets, Zendesk, etc in order to communicate with all stakeholders

**Qualifications:**

* **High sense of responsibility:** you take responsibility for implementing all aspects of operational standards
* **Extreme reliability:** you are on-time, all the time, and you ensure balls do not get dropped
* **Operationally savvy:** you execute, execute, execute. You have a high level of attention to detail, you ensure every delivery goes out on time and in good condition, you maintain food safety rules, etc.
* **Operational strategy:** You identify and reduce operational variances around the hub to streamline operations. You innovate and test, and can measure results of various initiatives you implement on the ground.
* **Communications:** you keep in regular communication with your GM; you know when to escalate and when to keep your GM in the loop so there are no surprises.
* **Problem solving:** when a logistics provider doesn't show up, when an order goes missing -- you can follow SOPs cleanly -- and also come up with a solution if an SOP doesn't exist
* **Coachable on technology & data:** you can learn to manage all tools with minimal error; can debug where necessary (retool, slack, etc). You can learn to read dashboards to understand your performance, and use numbers to make decisions.
* **Seek to serve:** You’re a great representation of Shef’s values towards our chefs. You’re our key person on the ground, and the ultimate host.
* **You’re able to be on your feet for 5 hours a day**

**Preferred qualifications (not required):**

* Hospitality experience
* Customer service experience
* Warehousing, logistics, or other operations experience

***Important: This is a part-time position that is in-market and on-site. We anticipate this team member will work on-location from 9:00a-3:00p on Sunday & Monday (12 hours per week).***

**--**

*For individuals who require an accommodation during the interview process, please advise your company contact.*

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

SUMMARY  
The Senior Marketing Coordinator develops messages for print and digital forms of marketing, and copyedits content written by self and other members of the Marketing Department team. The incumbent handles daily administrative approval items in customer relationship management (CRM) and timekeeping platforms, and supports marketing campaign/project enhancements and communications for the Marketing department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  

* Write messages through various content types including print collateral, website content, brochures, publications, product descriptions, press releases, announcements, and other forms of marketing.
* Copyedit content written by self and team members for spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation to ensure accuracy and brand consistency. Work closely with designers and marketing team members to update and amend written content according to feedback.
* Conduct research, monitor marketing trends and support competitive marketing campaigns.
* Maintain marketing database and photo library, and filing systems for paper and electronic documents.
* Fulfill administrative tasks such as sample order entry, and maintaining marketing documents and resource materials related marketing and communication activities.
* Handles daily administrative approval items in Salesforce CRM platform (e.g., sample order entry, Co-op credit, purchase requisitions, check requests, trip reports, IRAs), and timekeeping platform.
* Provide marketing project and tradeshow support.
* Provide customer service and sales support as needed.
* Exercise judgment to balance priorities and communicate to teams to meet and exceed project deadlines and commitments; keep the marketing team informed of projects and progress.
* Assist with special projects and other job-related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE  
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or Public Relations AND 3 years of related experience, OR equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  
Prior experience in corporate content creation, Social Media, and other creative content development is a plus.

COMPUTER SKILLS  
Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and proficiency with PC and Mac platforms and tools. Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator) is a plus, but not necessary.

LANGUAGE SKILLS  
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. The ability to present ideas effectively using both oral and written skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and co-workers.

jobs.title: Event Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**The Miles Lawrence Company**  
**Part-Time | On-Call / Event-Based**  
**$20–$25 per hour**  
**Orange County & Greater Los Angeles Area**

**About The Miles Lawrence Company**

The Miles Lawrence Company is a growing hospitality, events, media, and lifestyle company built around creating memorable experiences and community-centered brands.

Our portfolio includes Tipsy Toucan Private Bartending, Shoreline Food Catering, The Cotton Candy Co., Streetlights Play, Lucky Lizard Landscaping, La Mirada Blog, and other developing concepts.

From private parties and corporate events to community gatherings and our own in-house experiences, our team believes the smallest details can make the biggest difference.

As we continue to grow, we're building a team of energetic, dependable people who enjoy events, hospitality, creativity, and working behind the scenes to bring experiences to life.

**The Role**

We're looking for **Event Operations Assistants** to join our growing event team.

This is a flexible, part-time, and event-based position that is especially well suited for college students, young professionals, or anyone looking for supplemental weekend work and hands-on experience in events, hospitality, and small business operations.

You'll essentially be an extra set of capable hands wherever they're needed.

No two events will look exactly the same. One weekend you may help transform a backyard for a private event. Another weekend you might assist our bartending, catering, children's entertainment, or activation teams at a client event.

We're looking for people who can take direction, move quickly, stay positive, and aren't afraid to jump in and help.

**What You'll Do**

Responsibilities may include:

* Assisting with event setup and breakdown
* Loading and unloading event equipment and supplies
* Setting up tables, chairs, décor, bars, signage, lighting, and event activations
* Helping prepare Miles Lawrence Company events and client events
* Restocking supplies throughout events
* Keeping event spaces organized and guest-ready
* Supporting bartending, catering, entertainment, and activation teams as needed
* Assisting with cleanup and packing equipment after events
* Running supplies or completing small event-related errands
* Helping solve unexpected problems during an event
* Working alongside event leads to ensure events run smoothly
* Representing the Miles Lawrence Company professionally around clients and guests

This is a **hands-on position**. You should be comfortable moving equipment, being on your feet, working both indoors and outdoors, and helping wherever the team needs you.

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Dependable and punctual
* Friendly and professional
* Comfortable taking direction
* Able to work independently after receiving instructions
* Detail-oriented
* Flexible when plans change
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment
* Willing to do both the fun and not-so-glamorous parts of event production
* Comfortable interacting with clients, vendors, guests, and other team members
* Interested in hospitality, events, entrepreneurship, marketing, production, or small business

**Previous event experience is not required.**

We're more interested in finding people with a strong work ethic, good attitude, and willingness to learn.

**Schedule**

There are **no guaranteed weekly hours**. Team members will be offered available event shifts and may accept shifts based on their availability.

This makes the position particularly suitable for students and people looking for flexible supplemental work.

Event shifts may range from approximately 4–10 hours depending on the event.

**Physical Requirements**

Because this is an event operations role, applicants should be able to:

* Remain on their feet for extended periods
* Frequently bend, lift, carry, and move event equipment
* Safely lift approximately 40–50 lbs
* Work outdoors when necessary
* Work occasional late nights and weekends

**Compensation**

**$20–$25/hour**, depending on experience and level of responsibility.

There will also be opportunities for team members who consistently perform well to take on greater responsibility within our growing group of companies.

**Why Join Us?**

This isn't a traditional desk job.

You'll get exposure to multiple growing businesses and learn firsthand what goes into producing events, running hospitality companies, developing brands, and creating memorable experiences.

For someone interested in entrepreneurship, events, hospitality, marketing, or business, you'll have the opportunity to see a growing company from the inside.

As our companies grow, we want our best people to grow with us.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction telling us:

* A little about yourself
* Your current school, job, or primary commitment
* Why this position interests you
* Your availability
* Any relevant event, hospitality, customer service, leadership, or team experience

We value **attitude, reliability, and initiative** just as much as previous experience.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

------------------

The Inside Account Management team is part of DoorDash's SMB account management engine.

We are dedicated to the retention, satisfaction, and growth of 8,500+ high-impact restaurant partners. We pride ourselves on being data-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to championing small business success.

**About the Role**

As a Merchant Success Manager (MSM), you will play a critical role in supporting and growing DoorDash's SMB restaurant partners. You will manage a focused book of approximately 75 merchants, building long‑term relationships and helping restaurant owners improve their performance on the platform. Through consistent outbound calls, email outreach, and data‑driven conversations, you will guide merchants on how to increase visibility, optimize their listings, adopt DoorDash products, and ultimately grow their revenue.

You'll be accountable for hitting weekly and quarterly KPIs — including high‑volume outbound activity (dials, talk time), strategic merchant calls, QBR delivery, and results tied to revenue, operational metrics, ads/promo adoption, and fair pricing conversations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys fast‑paced, high‑volume merchant engagement, uses data to drive decisions, and feels energized by work that blends sales, account management, and portfolio‑level strategy.

jobs.description:
**Production Coordinator**  
*Updated: September 19, 2026*

**Company:** PALY Hollywood  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (on-site)  
**Reports to:** Production Manager  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment:** Full-time

**ABOUT PALY**

PALY embodies the act of storytelling. Through the release of seasonal collections, the brand explores a range of subjects, with an emphasis on Hollywood history, infamous crimes, conspiracies, drug tales, and the cult phenomenon.

Rooted in carefully referenced alternative motifs, scribbled drawings, and delicate hand-worked detailing, PALY presents a vision of luxury clothing that feels authentically vintage. Each piece bears an individual, one-of-one quality. These sensibilities are reimagined through the distinctive lens of film and Hollywood iconography.

Founded in 2022 and based in Los Angeles, PALY has grown quickly across wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels, with distribution in North America, the EU, the Middle East, and Asia. We are at the stage where the brand is moving faster than the operating infrastructure beneath it.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Production Coordinator keeps production moving. The role owns the day-to-day detail behind the calendar: purchase orders, ERP entry, sample movement, follow-up with vendors, and the records that let everyone else work from accurate information.

This role is the difference between a calendar that exists on paper and one the company can trust. Accuracy and follow-through matter more here than seniority.

This is a hands-on, on-site role with real growth potential into production management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Purchase Orders & ERP Entry**

* Write and enter fabric, trim, and production purchase orders accurately and on time
* Enter and maintain style setup, cost sheets, fabric content, and country of origin in Sync
* Apply and manage UPCs for all styles moving into production
* Audit style master information before collection launch and correct errors before they move downstream
* Inactivate styles that do not move forward to sales or production
* Maintain accurate size, color, and SKU data so allocation and shipping are not working from bad information

**Calendar & WIP Support**

* Maintain the style-level WIP and update it in the ERP no less than weekly
* Track every style against its calendar milestones and flag anything slipping
* Chase vendors for confirmations, updated dates, and missing information
* Prepare the weekly production report for the Director of Production and the sales team
* Maintain the pre-production calendar and keep deadlines visible to design, development, and production

**Sample Tracking & Movement**

* Track proto, fit, salesman, TOP, and photoshoot samples from request through receipt
* Log, label, and organize samples so any style can be located on demand
* Pick up and deliver samples across factories, wash houses, printers, and the office
* Coordinate sample sets for market, trade shows, photoshoots, and PR, and confirm each set is complete before it leaves
* Follow up on outstanding samples so approvals are not the reason a date is missed

**Materials & Vendor Follow-Up**

* Track fabric, trim, and treatment orders in transit and confirm arrival against need dates
* Chase lab dips, strike-offs, and trim submits through approval
* Flag shortages and substitutions early, before they stop a cut
* Maintain vendor contact records, terms, and compliance documentation

**Receiving & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate inbound receiving between the factories, Sync, and the warehouse team
* Confirm received quantities by style, color, and size against the purchase order, and raise discrepancies
* Support invoice review by verifying that what was received matches what is billed
* Conduct on-site visits to factories and the warehouse to check quality and progress

**Quality & Records**

* Assist with quality control, including review of samples and bulk before release
* Support fit sessions by preparing samples, taking notes, and distributing comments
* Maintain detailed, organized records of production workflows, adjustments, and outcomes
* Review vendor compliance requirements per customer and check for changes quarterly

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 2+ years in apparel production, production coordination, or a closely related support role
* Working knowledge of an apparel ERP or PLM system
* Strong Excel skills
* Exceptional organization, accuracy, and follow-through
* Comfortable chasing people for answers and persistent about getting them
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for sample runs and factory visits
* Basic understanding of garment construction, fabric, and wash

**Preferred**

* Experience in luxury, contemporary, or elevated streetwear
* Experience with washed or garment-dyed product
* Working Spanish

Pay: $26.00 - $36.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About VILIANTE LLC**

VILIANTE LLC is a Los Angeles-based professional beauty supply company providing premium single-use disposable towels for salons, barbershops, spas, med spas, skincare businesses, and other beauty professionals.

We are hiring a Field Sales Representative to help grow our presence throughout Glendale and the surrounding Los Angeles area.

Position Overview

This is a field-based, customer-facing sales role. The representative will visit local beauty businesses in person, introduce VILIANTE products, explain their benefits, build relationships with owners and managers, and follow up with prospective and existing customers.

This is not a remote sales position. The role involves local business visits throughout Glendale and nearby Los Angeles areas.

Responsibilities

* Visit salons, barbershops, spas, med spas, skincare businesses, and other professional beauty businesses in assigned local areas.

* Introduce VILIANTE products to business owners, managers, and beauty professionals.

* Explain product features, benefits, pricing, and purchasing options clearly and professionally.

* Identify potential customers and initiate conversations with new businesses.

* Build and maintain positive long-term relationships with prospective and existing customers.

* Follow up with interested businesses after visits, product introductions, or samples.

* Listen to customer needs, answer questions, and handle objections professionally.

* Maintain organized records of visits, customer interactions, follow-ups, and next actions.

* Follow assigned sales routes and daily priorities while managing time effectively.

* Communicate customer feedback, objections, and market insights to management.

* Represent VILIANTE LLC professionally during all customer interactions.

Qualifications

* Professional communication ability in both Armenian and English is required.

* Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

* Comfortable approaching new businesses and speaking with owners, managers, and staff.

* Sales, retail, customer service, account management, business development, beauty, salon, spa, or other customer-facing experience is preferred.

* Previous field sales or outside sales experience is a plus, but not required.

* Strong customer-service mindset and ability to build professional relationships.

* Reliable follow-up and good organizational skills.

* Comfortable using a smartphone, maps, email, and basic customer-tracking tools.

* Able to work independently and manage local business visits efficiently.

* Comfortable traveling locally throughout Glendale and surrounding Los Angeles areas to visit businesses in person.

What We Offer

* $19–$35 per hour

* Training provided

* Opportunity to grow with a developing professional beauty supply company

Location

Glendale, California and surrounding Los Angeles areas

Field-based / In-person

* Paid training

jobs.title: Design & Product Development Assistant
jobs.description:
**SYRN**

Design & Product Development Assistant

This is a fully in-office position, five days a week. (Santa Monica, CA)

**About SYRN**

SYRN is redefining modern intimates through thoughtful design, elevated essentials, and

immersive brand storytelling. Every drop, campaign, and collaboration is its own world, and

every piece we make has to live up to it. We're a fast-growing, founder-led brand where the

team runs lean, moves fast, and cares deeply about craft.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Design & Product Development Assistant who is excited to learn how product comes to life at SYRN, from first concept to production-ready piece.

You'll support our Design, Product Development, and Technical Design teams throughout the

seasonal product creation process across intimates, sleepwear, loungewear, apparel, and

accessories. You'll help bring product from initial concept through sampling, fittings, and

production handoff, supporting seasonal organization, materials, samples, PLM maintenance, vendor submissions, and day-to-day development needs.

This is an entry-level role, ideal for someone who is proactive, organized, and visually minded,

and who wants hands-on experience across both the creative and operational sides of product creation. You'll gain exposure to everything from seasonal concept development, materials, color, and assortment organization to sampling, vendor communication, fittings, PLM, and production preparation.

**What You'll Do**

- Support the Design team with day-to-day seasonal design and development needs

across intimates, sleepwear, loungewear, apparel, and accessories.

- Maintain and organize physical and digital fabric, trim, print, color, and inspiration

archives, including fabric rails and material libraries.

- Maintain the Pantone and color library, including seasonal color tracking and naming, so

standards stay organized and easily accessible.

- Assist with seasonal trend, competitive, product, color, print, fabric, trim, and inspiration

research.

- Support the creation and maintenance of seasonal Miro boards, including CAD

placement, color updates, assortment changes, and collection organization under

Design direction.

- Assist with mood boards, presentations, and seasonal design materials, and keep

artwork, print, and graphic files organized throughout development.

- Prepare samples, materials, and presentation boards for design reviews, line reviews,

and cross-functional meetings.

- Organize and track Design submissions, including fabrics, trims, prints, embroideries,

lab dips, and strike-offs.

- Support day-to-day coordination across the product development lifecycle, from initial

sampling through production handoff.

- Manage the tracking, labeling, and storage of development, fit, marketing, e-commerce,

photoshoot, and production samples.

- Receive, log, organize, and distribute incoming vendor packages and submissions, and

coordinate outgoing samples and shipments.

- Maintain physical and digital libraries for fabrics, trims, packaging, lab dips, and strike-

offs, keeping them aligned with WFX records.

- Prepare and send vendor submissions, references, samples, and development

packages, and support vendor follow-up to keep development deadlines and seasonal

milestones on track.

- Organize and maintain development and technical design documentation, including tech

packs, BOMs, spec sheets, vendor communications, and approval records.

- Track TOP samples and other production-stage submissions as needed.

- Support the maintenance of accurate product, material, sample status, and development

information within WFX PLM, including library optimization, naming standardization,

duplicate cleanup, and data accuracy audits.

- Provide general administrative support, seasonal and office organization, and cross-

functional follow-up for Design, Product Development, and Technical Design.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Fashion Design, Product Development,

Merchandising, Textiles, or a related field.

- 0–2 years of relevant internship, assistant, or entry-level experience within fashion,

apparel, or product development.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, samples, and priorities in a fast-paced environment

where priorities may shift quickly.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of assigned tasks from start to

finish.

- Strong interest in fashion design, product development, and garment construction and

fit.

- Basic understanding of fabrics, trims, garment construction, color, and apparel

development preferred.

- Experience with or willingness to learn WFX or another PLM system.

- Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Miro, Microsoft Office, and/or Google

Workspace is a plus.

- Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and comfortable working across Design, Product

Development, Technical Design, Production, and Operations.

- Able to work in the office five days a week.

**Equal Opportunity**

SYRN is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive

team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Santa Monica, CA 90404 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Manufacturing Automation
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Manufacturing Automation team is seeking a Project Coordinator. The Manufacturing Automation team is responsible for the design, integration, and deployment of automated manufacturing systems across Anduril factories. You will help coordinate deployment and communication of new tools, processes, equipment, and capabilities across the company. You will help in the daily tasks that ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget, whether that is organizing a million-dollar purchase request or assembling a desk.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Project Coordination:** Assist in the organization and execution of projects. Assist in the organization of finances and submitting purchase requests. Distill meeting notes into actionable items and routinely own following up.
* **Communication:** Help facilitate communication between product line engineers, manufacturing engineers, and cross-functional teams. Manage documentation of internal resources.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 1–2 years of professional experience as a project or program coordinator
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally
* A reliable self-starter, highly organized, resourceful, with attention to detail
* A team player who is highly collaborative with the ability to handle complex projects
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge and/or experience of Confluence/Jira, SharePoint, and Airtable

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Veregy is an award-winning NAESCO-Accredited decarbonization company focusing on accelerating and simplifying Energy Transition. We provide turnkey engineering and construction services designed to reduce our clients' energy and operating costs through the implementation of energy efficiency and infrastructure upgrades, smart building technology, fleet EV infrastructure, clean energy generation, and sustainability.  
  
Do you want to be part of a TEAM who delivers Eco-Friendly Environments that Transform Lives? Then you are in the right place…start the application process today!

**Summary of Position Functions**  
  
The Construction Project Coordinator undertakes and performs a variety of support tasks and assignments to support office and field work performed by one or more Project Managers, Senior Project Managers and/or others as assigned. Acts as a liaison between Field employees and Accounting.

**Essential Position Functions**

* Transitions preconstruction projects to implementation projects.
* Enters all project related data into Viewpoint (by Vista) (budgets, contract amounts, schedule of values, etc).
* Requests performance and payment bonds, certificates of insurance (and renewals), and day preliminary notices, as applicable and tracks and follows up as required.
* Assists in developing the project schedule of values and enters into Viewpoint and/or client’s billing format.
* Assists in preparing monthly billings and lien waivers, where required, and projecting project billings.
* Updates monthly billing information in Viewpoint and billing information into bond log, monthly.
* Follows-up on accounts receivables and coordinates receipts with the accounting department.
* Prepares subcontract agreements and purchase agreements and submits to subcontractor and/or vendor for execution.
* Enters change order information in Viewpoint and prepares formal change order documents to submit to subcontractors and/or vendors and, updates applicable tracking logs.
* Responds to subcontractor/vendor preliminary notices.
* Assists with the preparation and tracking of submittals and, maintains submittal/equipment log.
* Sends tax privilege exempt and related financial documents to general contractors.
* Prepares project specific badges, badge logs and coordinates updates with the superintendent.
* Prepares O&M manuals and various close-out documents at completion of project.
* Manages compliance with federal and CA laws including CA Department of Industrial Relations and Davis Bacon prevailing wage regulations.

Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work in other areas to cover absences or relief to equalize peak work periods or otherwise balance the workload.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  

* None.

**Education and Qualifications**  
  
To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or two to five years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two years of project assistance, project coordination, administrative assistant or closely related experience in commercial construction, HVAC, or related field required.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Knowledge of Veregy’s services and processes is required which can be obtained through intellect, technical inclination, and dedication to gain such knowledge.
* Knowledge of the principles of file and records management and the basic principles of bookkeeping and/or accounting
* Knowledge (Intermediate to advanced) of various operating systems, software products (e.g. MS Office, etc.), is required.
* Ability to work independently and efficiently manage time / workload.
* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines, deliverables, and other requirements.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relations with co-workers, vendors, customers, and the general public.
* Ability to effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers and staff.
* Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and tactfully negotiate priority with end users.
* Ability to work under deadline pressure and extra hours if needed.

* Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Plans.

* Employer Sponsored Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are looking for a Talent Operations Coordinator to help enable Anduril's Talent Acquisition (TA) team to scale effectively. As a member of the TA Operations team, you will support data integrity and day-to-day system upkeep across our TA tech stack (including Greenhouse and ChartHop), serving as a first line of support for TA team stakeholders with questions or issues.  
  
This role sits at the heart of a large, rapidly scaling recruiting team, giving you outsized impact on the smooth day-to-day operations of TA. You'll get hands-on exposure to a wide range of TA tools, systems, and processes, with the opportunity to learn quickly and grow within Talent Operations. We're looking for someone detail-oriented and customer-focused who enjoys helping others, stays organized amid a lot of moving pieces, and is excited to build a foundation for a career in TA Ops.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Support data cleanliness across the TA tech stack:
* + Assist with regular audits of Greenhouse and ChartHop data
  + Flag data discrepancies and partner with stakeholders to get them corrected
  + Help maintain documentation on data entry standards and processes
* Answer questions and support stakeholders:
* + Serve as a first point of contact for TA team questions on Greenhouse, ChartHop, ContactOut, TextExpander, and LinkedIn Recruiter
  + Troubleshoot common issues, escalating more complex or technical issues to senior TA Ops team members
  + Help field and triage requests coming through the TA ticketing system / Slack channels
* Support systems operations:
* + Help manage user access and basic account administration across TA tools
  + Own regular workflows across systems, such as processing backfills, resolving system integration errors, and other recurring data/system maintenance tasks
* Additional projects, documentation, and tool exploration as needed â there's always something new to learn!

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1+ years of experience in a fast-paced Talent Acquisition, HR, or Operations function (Recruiting Coordinator experience a plus)
* Experience using an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) or similar HR/recruiting systems
* Customer-service mentality: enjoys working with stakeholders to solve problems and answer questions
* Detail-oriented: strong attention to accuracy and consistency, especially with recruiting and headcount data
* Communicative: clear, proactive communication with cross-functional stakeholders
* Organized and action-oriented: able to juggle multiple requests and follow through on the details
* Eager to learn: comfortable in an undefined, fast-changing environment, and motivated to grow within Talent Operations
* Self-sufficient problem-solver who also knows when to ask for help or escalate

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience using a headcount management tool or HRIS (ChartHop or Workday preferred)

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

* Follow up on past-due invoices and achieve monthly accounts receivable goals.
* Address and resolve billing inquiries professionally and efficiently.

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education is a plus.
* Proven customer service experience, with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly.
* Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and other software.

**Preferred Skills**

* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a focus on delivering quality.
* Experience with programs such as NetSuite, ABS, and supplier portals is a plus.
* Experience working in a spreadsheet environment (Microsoft Excel)

**Programs Used**

* ABS, Bi-Launch, Microsoft Office, NetSuite, Outlook, Penn Emblem Portal, Shipworks, Uniform Market/Seller’s Commerce, and other supplier portals.

**What We Offer**

* A dynamic work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Comprehensive training on our products, systems, and processes.

If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for customer service and sales, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Help us grow our direct sales channel while making a meaningful impact on our customers’ businesses.

* Exceptional Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off for vacation and sick time

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
MyCareConnect is dedicated to transforming early childhood education through innovative SaaS solutions that empower families, childcare providers, nonprofits, governments, and employers. Our mission is to ensure every child has access to quality childcare programs that help them reach their full potential. With a strong presence across California and a commitment to expanding nationwide, we are passionate about making a positive impact in communities everywhere.

**Who We Work With**  
Our software runs behind programs that families and providers across California rely on every day, including:

* Child Care San Diego (https://childcaresandiego.com) — county-wide childcare resource and enrollment hub
* Early Learning for All SF (https://www.sf.gov/early-learning-for-all) — San Francisco's universal early care and education program
* Long Beach Early Learning Hub (https://thehublb.org) — coordinated enrollment for Universal Pre-K
* Stanford WorkLife Childcare (https://childcare.stanford.edu) — university employee childcare
* Harvard University Childcare (https://app.mycareconnect.io/hu/ccc/home) — employer-sponsored child care

**About the Role**

You’ll be a first point of contact for the agency staff who use our software. You’ll start by learning one of our products in depth, then help customers solve problems, answer their questions, and get the most out of our solutions. As your expertise grows, you’ll expand to additional products and play a bigger part in how we support customers and improve our software. You’ll work closely with our product, QA, and development teams.

No prior knowledge of childcare, subsidy programs, or government agencies is required. We’ll teach you the domain and our products through hands-on training. What we can’t teach is curiosity, persistence, and a commitment to seeing problems through.

**Who You Are**

* You enjoy helping people solve problems and are comfortable learning complex software and the processes behind it.
* You communicate clearly and can explain complicated issues in a way that makes sense to anyone.
* You own problems from start to finish, and you know when to bring in the right person.
* You’re detail-oriented, follow through on commitments, and can juggle competing priorities.
* You’re coachable, adapt well to change, and look for ways to make things better.
* Most of all, you care about helping customers feel heard, supported, and confident.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own support requests end to end:** Manage support tickets, troubleshoot issues, and keep customers updated until each issue is resolved or escalated.
* **Investigate and document issues:** Troubleshoot software problems, spot patterns, and write up clear findings for QA and Development.
* **Help people find answers:** Maintain and create knowledge base articles, internal documentation, and customer-specific procedures.
* **Support training:** Help create release notes, tutorials, and training materials, and deliver online training for customers and internal teams.
* **Drive improvement:** Flag recurring issues and suggest improvements to our products, processes, documentation, and AI-assisted support tools.
* **Assist with onboarding:** Support senior team members with agency implementations, data migrations, and other customer projects.
* **Deliver a consistent experience:** Follow support processes and help monitor and improve our service-level commitments.

**How You’ll Be Measured**

We’ll look at responsiveness, resolution quality, customer communication, follow-through, and meeting our SLA commitments. You’ll have clear goals and regular feedback from day one.

**Requirements**

* 1+ year of experience in customer service, support, or a similar customer-facing role
* Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining technical topics to non-technical users
* Ability to quickly learn new tools and concepts
* Attention to detail and a proactive approach to completing tasks
* Analytical skills: able to assess issues, prioritize, and **initiate solutions, not just report problems**
* Flexibility to adjust your schedule when business needs require

**Growth**

We believe in growing people from within. You’ll master one product first, then expand to additional products as your skills grow. Over time you’ll have opportunities to lead onboardings, shape our support processes, and help build the AI-supported tools that are changing how we serve customers.

Pay: $25.00 - $34.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid training

Application Question(s):

* Do you have at least 1 year of experience in customer service, support, or another customer-facing role? (Yes / No)
* Describe a time you had to learn a complex piece of software or process quickly. How did you go about it, and how did you know you'd learned it well enough?
* Tell us about a customer problem you owned from start to finish — including a point where you had to pull in someone else to get it solved.
* How have you used AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in your work or daily life? What worked and what didn't?

Education:

* Associate (Preferred)

We are expanding our dealer network across Southern California and are looking for motivated Outside Sales Representatives to introduce LLIGHTUP products to professional PPF, window tint, vinyl wrap, detailing, and automotive restyling shops.

* Maintain relationships with assigned dealer accounts and help generate repeat business
* Record shop visits, contacts, samples, follow-ups, and sales activity
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, pricing insights, and customer needs

* Comfortable walking into businesses and starting conversations with new people
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills
* Self-motivated, reliable, and results-oriented
* Comfortable working independently in the field
* Organized and able to consistently follow up with prospective customers
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

Compensation

* Approved business mileage reimbursement

* Opportunity to grow into a full-time Territory Sales position as LLIGHTUP expands

Territory

LLIGHTUP is in an early stage of expanding its U.S. dealer network, giving successful sales representatives an opportunity to grow with the brand and develop their own dealer territory.

Our product strategy focuses on providing professional installers with:

* A wide selection of Color PPF options
* Competitive dealer pricing
* Attractive dealer margin potential
* Low barriers to testing new products
* U.S.-based sales and dealer support

LLIGHTUP FILM will also be exhibiting at **SEMA 2026 in Las Vegas, Booth #12045**.

We are looking for people who want to help build a dealer network—not simply wait for inbound leads.

**Apply with your resume and a brief description of any sales, automotive, or business development experience.**

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

-----------------------

The Sales Representative I reports to the Sales Team Lead and promotes and sells Zimmer Biomet orthopedic products, including implants, surgical tools, and ZBEdge technologies, to healthcare professionals and facilities. This role builds upon foundational clinical and sales experience to contribute more strategically to account planning, surgeon engagement, and business growth. This role represents the first step in a performance-driven sales career path.

----------------------------

jobs.description:
Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 19, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 30%
  
  
Implements and coordinates graduate student fellowship programs administered by the Graduate Division.
  
Works with internal and external organizations to coordinate procedures.
  
Serves as expert resource to update applications and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies.
  
Analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
  
NSF GRFP Administration - 30%
  
  
Serves as campus-wide expert and steward of National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP).
  
Acts as student facing Coordinating Official, working with fellows, faculty, and staff to provide information, respond to inquiries about program policies, and interface with the NSF.
  
Interprets regulations and develops or recommends procedures to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
Reconciles large volumes of student data from multiple sources and adjusts Grants Roster Report. Coordinates yearly NSF GRFP info session.
  
Updates NSF GRFP Administration at UCB guide.
  
Works with fellows, GSAOs, and Berkeley Regional Services to ensure correct assessment and funding source.
  
  
Travel Grant Administration - 10%
  
  
Reviews Slate fellowship application data to administer the Graduate Division's Conference Travel Grant program.
  
Monitors, tracks, and makes awards in Campus Solutions.
  
Tracks budget and provides analysis of usage and suggestions on how to improve the process.
  
Provides individual counseling on non-routine, sensitive aid issues.
  
Exercises professional judgment to authorize changes in financial aid awards.
  
  
Fellowship and Block Grant Allocations - 10%
  
  
Provides annual Berkeley and Chancellor's Fellowship allocation information to divisional leadership and tracks their departmental allocations.
  
Monitors and tracks Chancellor's carry forward and other exceptions.
  
Delivers annual Block Grant memos to programs.
  
Memos provide yearly allocation amounts as well as Graduate Opportunity Program, Mentored Research Award, and UC Dissertation Year nomination amounts.
  
Recommends new or changes to policy in areas needing clarification, and supports the Director of Student Funding to identify solutions to existing fellowship program policies without precedent.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Administrative Coordinator**

**Job Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator oversees daily office administration and coordinates fire sprinkler, fire alarm, fire extinguisher, and suppression system service, inspection, and installation projects. This position manages technician scheduling, customer communication, billing, project documentation, and administrative compliance tracking.

Serving as a central point of contact for customers, technicians, dispatchers, vendors, sales, design, and management, the Administrative Coordinator helps ensure work is completed efficiently, on time, and in accordance with customer expectations. Success requires strong organizational and leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage changing priorities while providing professional, responsive service.

**Essential Duties**

* Coordinate daily technician schedules and service and inspection appointments based on availability, location, technician qualifications, project requirements, and customer needs.

* Plan efficient service routes, prioritize service requests, and promptly coordinate technician response to urgent repairs and emergency calls.

* Monitor work orders, project schedules, and inspection deadlines; follow up on incomplete work and communicate delays or scheduling changes.

* Reassign technicians and adjust resources to accommodate changing priorities, emergency calls, and last-minute scheduling changes.

* Communicate with local fire marshals regarding scheduling, permits, inspection documentation, and compliance inquiries; refer technical questions to appropriate personnel.

* Track field service orders, process customer invoices, record project costs, and maintain accurate billing and project records.

* Ensure technicians receive necessary job information, documentation, site access details, and resources before scheduled work.

* Serve as a primary contact and escalation point for commercial property managers and building owners regarding scheduling, project status, service updates, delays, and concerns.

* Prepare and submit fire department permit applications, business license paperwork, and technician certification documentation; monitor expiration dates and coordinate timely renewals to avoid lapses.

* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the service and project lifecycle to promote customer satisfaction.

* Collect required documentation and compile closeout packages for completed system installations.

* Maintain current customer, work order, and project information in service management systems and provide status updates as needed. Process, log, and distribute official fire alarm, sprinkler, and extinguisher inspection reports.

* Review documentation for completeness and accuracy, coordinate corrections or missing records, and support compliance with applicable state, local, and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) documentation and reporting requirements.

* Answer phones, handle incoming and outgoing mail, maintain files, order office supplies, and support daily office operations.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions designed to improve scheduling efficiency, project coordination, and customer satisfaction

* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support successful project completion and department operations.

Qualifications

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in dispatch, scheduling, project coordination, office administration, or related work; experience in fire protection, construction, HVAC, plumbing, or a similar service industry preferred.

* Project coordination or project management experience is strongly preferred; experience with budgeting, project tracking, and resource allocation preferred.

* Strong organizational, scheduling, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills, with the ability to maintain positive relationships with customers, technicians, vendors, and team members.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make timely decisions, work under pressure, and adapt to changing schedules and operational needs.

* High attention to detail and accuracy in billing, inspection reports, permit records, certification tracking, and other documentation that may affect building safety or code compliance.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

* Proficiency with field service management platforms, such as ServiceTrade, HindSite, or comparable systems.

* Familiarity with fire protection terminology, systems, codes, and standards, including NFPA standards, backflow preventers, and wet and dry sprinkler systems, highly preferred.

* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

**Education**

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* A combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted for the minimum requirements.

Reports to: Union Inspection Operations Manager

Classification: Non-exempt, In Person, Full Time

Supervisory: None

Disclaimer: This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the RLH Fire Protection, Inc.

Safety/Physical Requirements

* Mostly sedentary position, with some walking and standing required.

* Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

jobs.description:
* We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

* Clear and professional communication skills
* Able to work with urgency. We move fast, so does our interview process, you’ll make sure we maintain this velocity.

**Compensation and benefits**

* Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.
* Competitive base + equity.
* 401K match.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Annual offsite.
* Early-exercise stock options.
* 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US).

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

**Homeless Children’s Network**

**Position Title:** Development Coordinator (Temporary Role)

**SALARY:** $35-$40 per hour

**SCHEDULE:** Temporary role (3 month Contract), 40 hours/week; some evenings

**BENEFITS:** Health, Dental, and Vision insurance; Commuter stipend

**HOMELESS CHILDREN’S NETWORK MISSION STATEMENT**

Homeless Children’s Network’s (HCN) mission is to decrease the trauma of homelessness and domestic violence for children, youth, and families; to empower families; and to increase the effectiveness of collaborative efforts among service providers to end homelessness and poverty. Since 1992, HCN has empowered San Francisco’s underserved and historically marginalized communities citywide toward a brighter future with love, wholeness, and healing.

**About Homeless Children’s Network (HCN)**

Since 1992, HCN has been San Francisco’s leading nonprofit agency for comprehensive early intervention and mental health support for underserved and historically marginalized children, youth, and families experiencing homelessness, housing instability, or living in intergenerational poverty. Our mobile therapeutic model is both accessible and scalable, enabling clinicians to meet clients directly in the community. As the hub of a Collaborative of 60+ service agencies and community-based organizations, we serve over 2,500 clients each year, reaching those most reluctant to trust conventional mental health systems. Central to our work is our Afri-centric mental health and wellness model. This community-defined approach addresses health inequities and the persistent cycle of racism and trauma over generations. This model not only uplifts the Black/African American communities but also strengthens the behavioral health outcomes of all San Franciscans, fostering resilience, healing, and lasting change.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

HCN is seeking a hands-on Temporary Development Coordinator to support our development team through a busy season. Over the next three months, this role will help deliver events, support our year-end giving campaign, and assist with development and grants operations while team members are out.

This is a great fit for an organized, flexible fundraising professional who can step in quickly, juggle deadlines, and work well with a small, mission-driven team.

**Grant support (approx. 20%)**

* Update the grants calendar and track deadlines and submission confirmations for the Associate Development Director, Grants

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* 2+ years of nonprofit fundraising, event coordination or development operations experience
* Experience planning or supporting fundraising events from start to finish
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once
* Clear, professional writing and attention to detail
* Experience with a donor database (such as Raiser's Edge, Salesforce, Bloomerang or DonorPerfect)

* Available for occasional evening and weekend work around events

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of or commitment to serving children and families experiencing homelessness

**HCN’s Community Culture**

*Of all the above important qualifications, bring the heartfelt quality of compassion, with exquisite cultural responsiveness as a primary guiding quality, not only of your professional life, but of what you hold dear.*

*Please bring a strong analysis of how race, ethnicity, culture, language, region, poverty, sexual and gender identity, age, education, opportunities and resources generationally made available or not, and systemic oppressions impact a person’s mental health.*

*Please accept that HCN is a vibrant community that has a legacy that is of interest to you, and is also prompted to grow steadily, and with the respect of what has been done well central in the conversation.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

jobs.title: Key Account Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Key Accounts Sales Representative manages assigned Key Accounts within MFCP and is responsible for supporting sales and profit growth strategies for assigned customers. This role sells MFCP products and services, services existing accounts, develops new account opportunities, resolves customer issues, and coordinates cross-functionally to deliver a consistent customer experience across MFCP locations. The position requires seasoned sales and account management experience, a full understanding of the assigned area of specialization, and the ability to resolve a wide range of customer, pricing, and account-related issues in creative and effective ways.

**Salary: $70,000K - $150,000K | DOE**

**Primary Duties:**

* Manage assigned Key Accounts, including ownership of sales growth, profit targets, customer retention, and execution of short- and long-range account strategies.
* Sell MFCP products and services to assigned customers, service existing accounts, identify new account opportunities, and support growth across customer business units and locations.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and influencers through customer sales calls, business reviews, presentations, and ongoing communication.
* Field customer questions, resolve complaints or service issues, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely, consistent, and effective customer support.
* Analyze customer needs, account activity, pricing, profitability, sales performance, and business trends to determine appropriate solutions and recommendations.
* Independently resolve a wide range of account-related issues and escalate broader-impact or highly complex matters to management as appropriate.
