**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about, helping grow businesses and the communities that support them. To further this mission, we're looking for an experienced paid media operator to join our Consumer Marketing team at a pivotal time for DoorDash Ads and paid co-marketing.

The Cx Ads Paid team plans, launches and measures paid media campaigns with brand and CPG partners, working alongside Ads Integrated Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and our agency partners. The team is growing, and this person will help shape how paid marketing operates as it scales.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a strategic, decisive paid marketing leader to own Co-Marketing Paid Media strategy and operations in the US as it pertains to supporting Co-Marketing Merchant priorities. This role will support +20 strategic campaigns across $XXM covering CPG, Restaurant, and New Vertical industries. You will set the operating model, make the decisions that keep the campaign on track against launch timing, ROAS performance, and advertisers commitments. You will be the voice of Paid in cross-functional forums, arriving with data, a clear point of view and a recommendation, and you will lead agency and platform partners as the single accountable owner. This is your opportunity to influence and own a Paid marketing function as a lead, touching channel decision making and strategy with Director + visibility.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the end to end paid marketing operations, from intake and planning through launch, in-flight management and recap
* Make independent decisions on campaign operations and bring a clear recommendation to cross-functional discussion: For example channel mix, creative, and optimization strategies.
* Problem Solving: When there are unknowns, be the central driver to align on things like budgets, partnership commitments, and required approvals
* Lead agencies and platform partners such as our Media Agency, Meta and The Trade Desk, from brief to delivery
* Drive strategic projects end to end, including building channel playbooks, process revamps and the test-and-learn agenda
* Lead and develop a team of 2 (with opportunity to scale), delegating ownership of processes and planning capacity against the campaign calendar
* Must have experience interacting with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
* Leadership Communication Opportunity: Keep leadership and partners informed with proactive updates, early risk flags and escalations that come with a proposed solution
* Deliver recap reports and performance readouts with a clear narrative and benchmarks, ready for Marketing and Sales review

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

You're a decisive, results-oriented marketer who has led paid media programs and XFN teams. You form a point of view from data, act on it, and keep the right people informed along the way. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, delegating work you should not be doing yourself, and holding partners to a high bar. You have experience managing leadership and can write and speak concisely to such an audience

* 5-8 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, campaign management or marketing operations
* Experience managing agencies and paid channels such as CTV/OLV, programmatic, paid social, and DOOH
* Strong command of campaign measurement, including ROAS, benchmarking and root cause analysis of performance
* Track record of owning cross-functional projects and decisions without direct authority
* Sound judgment on when to decide, when to align and when to escalate
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with examples of leadership-ready updates and recommendations
* Experience building and scaling processes, trackers and playbooks
* [Preferred] Experience in CPG, QSR or marketplace co-marketing, and with tools such as Sigma, iSpot or Monday.com

**Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash**
---------------------------------------

* We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do* - on every project, every day.
* We are learning - We're not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it's scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute.
* We are customer obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
* We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.
* We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

We expect this position to be filled by 07/12/2026

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspective

jobs.title: Medicare Enrollment Sales Representative II
jobs.description:
**About NYC Health + Hospitals**
--------------------------------

  

MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of NYC Health + Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.

Purpose of Position:
  
Under varying degrees of supervision, identifies qualified Medicare participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives, documents consumer contracts, and processes grievances. Moreover, maintains a positive public relations presence within the community, provider agencies, and with city and state regulatory agencies. Additionally, may provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff. There are three Assignment Levels
  
within this class of positions; all personnel perform related work.

**Work Shifts**
---------------

  

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

  

Level I
  
Under supervision, performs the following typical tasks:
  
  
1. Implements methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.
  
2. Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community-at-large.
  
3. Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas including but not limited to senior centers, provider sites,
  
churches, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, etc.
  
4. Provides all benefit/service related information to members, applicants, and providers.
  
5. Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow-up activity.
  
6. Processes all member demographic changes.
  
7. Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.
  
8. Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.
  
9. Performs other related tasks as directed.

  

Level II
  
Under supervision, with latitude for independent judgment and decision making, performs the work of Assignment Level I at a higher level, and/or the following typical tasks:
  
  
1. May act as preceptor to subordinate Enrollment Sales Representatives to facilitate their understanding of MetroPlus objectives, operations and site specific information.
  
2. Implements and monitors appropriate methods, activities and action plans necessary to regularly achieve accelerated predetermined enrollment objectives.
  
3. Ensures appropriate and accurate documentation of call center plan enrollments and field activities.
  
4. Provides assistance and facilitates communications to sales/customer services management team.
  
5. Participates in bi-weekly and monthly sales/marketing meetings.
  
6. Performs related duties as directed.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

1. Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the
  
New York State Insurance Department; and
  
2. Possession of a High School diploma or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a
  
High School Equivalency Program; and,
  
3. Satisfactory completion of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel;
  
and,
  
4. One year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,
  
5. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  
However, all incumbents must possess the required licensure as described in one
  
above.
  
6. Knowledge of a second language may be required.
  
  
For appointment to Level II:
  
1. One year of experience in Assignment Level I or one additional year of experience as
  
described above.
  
  
For appointment to Level III:
  
1. One year of experience in Assignment Level II or two additional years of experience
  
as described above.
  
  
Special Notes:
  
Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the
  
New York State Insurance Department must be maintained in order to remain in this
  
position. Possession of a valid New York State Drivers License may be required.
  
The use of this position is restricted to MetroPlus only.

**Benefits**
------------

  

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

**How To Apply**
----------------

  

If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

jobs.description:
Description:

**AdaptHealth Opportunity – Apply Today!**

**About AdaptHealth**

At AdaptHealth we offer full-service home medical equipment and related services that empower patients to live their best lives – beyond the hospital and at home.

With supporting locations across the nation, AdaptHealth is the vital link in the healthcare ecosystem that bridges the gap between patients, providers, and high-quality, compassionate care.

If you’re passionate about making a meaningful and lasting difference in the lives of patients, we invite you to explore a career with AdaptHealth.

**The Adapt Difference**

* **Commitment to Our People – Support, Development, and Advancement Opportunities**
* **Competitive Compensation and Incentives**
* **Comprehensive Total Rewards & Benefits**
* **Industry-Leading Care & Innovation**
* **Responsible Environmental Stewardship**

**Position Summary:**

The Healthcare Partner is responsible for building and managing strategic relationships with healthcare providers, distributors, and industry partners to drive revenue growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and promote the company’s products and services. This role combines sales expertise, market knowledge, and relationship-building skills to deliver innovative solutions that address the needs of healthcare providers, payers, and partners.

**Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:**

* Partnership Development and Management:
* Identify and cultivate relationships with healthcare providers, distributors, and industry partners.
* Establish mutually beneficial partnerships to expand the company’s market reach.
* Regularly engage partners to align business objectives and growth strategies.
* Conduct daily outside sales visits to establish new business relationships and maintain existing ones with referral sources in the medical community.
* Meet in person with customers to identify needs, build relationships, and drive business growth.
* Travel to assigned territories to generate leads, provide accurate information on services, negotiate contracts, and deliver exceptional customer service.
* Sales Strategy Execution:
* Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets through effective partner engagement.
* Design and implement sales strategies tailored to each partner’s needs.
* Conduct presentations, product demonstrations, and negotiations to close deals.
* Market Insights and Analysis:
* Research and monitor industry trends, competitive landscapes, and regulatory developments.
* Leverage insights to identify new opportunities and refine sales approaches.
* Provide feedback to internal teams to influence product development and marketing strategies.
* Collaboration and Communication:
* Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, ensuring timely responses and resolution of issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing, operations, and customer success, to deliver a seamless partner experience.
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and partner meetings.
* Performance Measurement and Reporting:
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to partner sales.
* Use CRM tools to maintain up-to-date records of partner interactions and pipeline activities.
* Analyze results and recommend improvements for future growth.
* Participates in obtaining prescribing provider orders/signatures for appropriate documentation and original prescriptions while on-site when the Intake team is unable to do so.

* Completes assigned compliance training and other educational programs as required.
* Maintains compliant with AdaptHealth’s Compliance Program.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

* Results-driven with a strong sense of accountability.
* Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving skills.
* Highly adaptable to fast-paced and dynamic work environments.
* Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare markets, including providers, payers, and regulatory environments.
* Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent ability to communicate both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to communicate complex solutions effectively to diverse audiences.
* Ability to work independently and with a team.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects.
* Mental alertness and the ability to properly treat confidential information.
* Proficient computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office

Requirements:

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or equivalent experience in B2B or B2C Sales.
* Experience preferred in developing and maintaining client relationships, driving sales growth, and meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Valid and unrestricted driver’s license in the state of residence

**Experience Requirements per Seniority Level:**

* Healthcare Partner: Three (3) years of work-related experience is required.
* Senior Healthcare Partner: Five (5) years of work-related experience is required.
* Principal Healthcare Partner: Eight (8) years of work-related experience is required.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Must be able to bend, stoop, stretch, stand, and sit for extended periods.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions of wrists, hands, and/or fingers due to extensive computer use.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

As an SDR at Outset, you will be on the front lines of prospecting and driving new business opportunities. You’ll prospect, research, and engage with potential enterprise customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting (calls, emails, social channels) to source leads.
* Source qualified leads from industry conference lead lists, webinars, and other marketing activations.
* Attend industry conferences to network and generate new business along with the rest of the GTM team.
* Strategically identify and engage with decision-makers, tailoring outreach to address key business needs and pain points.
* Collaborate closely with Enterprise Account Executives, ensuring seamless handoff of qualified leads.
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline generation targets.
* Leverage CRM tools to track outreach activity, measure success, and identify areas for improvement.
* Work cross-functionally with marketing, GTM, and product teams to refine messaging and share market feedback.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to engage and influence senior-level executives.
* High degree of organization, accountability, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Sales Navigator, Outreach, or Apollo).
* Self-starter approach and comfort operating in a dynamic startup environment.
* Resourceful and persistent in every task they take on
* **Bonus:** 1-2 years of experience as an SDR at a SaaS or AI company.

**NOTE:** This role may involve travel up to 20% of the time.

Compensation Range: $80K - $110K

Unity. Loyalty. Advancement. Charity. It’s what drives United Legwear & Apparel Co. to be the best global designer, manufacturer, and distributor of legwear, bodywear, apparel, and accessories. Founded in 1998 by Isaac E. Ash to make the very best legwear on the market, ULAC is an industry leader offering a full range of products for babies, kids, teens, and adults. We strive to sell our products at affordable prices for families. Hard work and exponential growth year on year has transformed ULAC into a global apparel and accessories company.

**About the Job**

At ULAC the Production Assistant is responsible for providing support to the Production team in the day-to-day operations in their designated area (accessories or bodywear/legwear). This position will be involved in daily projects and responsibilities such as sample management, product testing, factory compliance, and quality assurance. The Production Assistant will help facilitate the execution of the department initiatives and goals.

**What You Will Do**

* Request, track and review pre-production and top of production samples
* Maintain sample tracking sheet and submitting samples to licensor
* Review and manage trim layouts such as packaging, UPC stickers and other label requirements.
* Gather customer compliant requirements from sales and communicate such to vendors for accurate labeling.
* Build customer specific labeling worksheet.
* Daily communication with overseas vendors.
* Track samples with our overseas vendors and maintain internal sample tracking sheets.
* Work closely with design, packaging, and development team for samples.
* Report directly to the production manager or director for sample and trim timelines.
* Work with Compliance-QA Team to obtain product fiber contents.
* Perform any other duties as assigned in support of the company needs and operations.

**What You Will Bring**

* High School Diploma or equivalent; prior office experience or education in a related field preferred.
* Experience in production or manufacturing, in the Fashion Industry.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic database systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workloads.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, maintaining attention to detail and deadlines.

**What We Offer**

At ULAC, we are committed to supporting the well-being and professional growth of our employees. Our comprehensive benefits package for all New York & New Jersey-based employees includes:

**Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance**

Coverage options to help care for your furry family members.

Competitive paid vacation and sick leave to support your work-life balance.

Paid time off to grieve and attend to personal matters following the loss of a loved one.

**PR Coordinator**

**University Ceremonies & Events**

The Division of Public Relations and Marketing Communications (PRMC) at Georgia State University is hiring an Event Coordinator in the University Events Management department. Reporting to the Director of University Events Management, the selected candidate will provide professional-level planning, operational coordination, and administrative management for University-wide annual and special events.

In this dual-capability role, the selected candidate will serve as the primary scheduler and operational contact for all UEM-managed venues (including Centennial Hall spaces and the University Club at Edgewood)—overseeing venue intake, managing complex event calendars, and collaborating directly with internal clients on space layouts and logistical needs. Simultaneously, the Event Coordinator will independently plan and execute an assigned portfolio of high-profile university events. Key responsibilities include building digital event registration systems, coordinating extensively with PRMC teams for event collateral and signage, tracking event budgets and expenses, and managing venue revenue and interdepartmental budget transfers for assigned spaces.

**Responsibilities include:**

**1. Venue Management & Internal Scheduling (50%)**

* **Calendar Management:** Oversee the intake, scheduling, and calendar reservations for clients utilizing event spaces managed by University Events Management (Centennial Hall, University Club at Edgewood, etc.).
* **Revenue Management**: Facilitate internal client payments and work alongside the business manager to process budget journal transfers.
* **Operational Liaison:** Coordinate day-to-day facility logistics by routing technical needs to the AV/IT teams and physical setup requirements to the Facilities team.
* **Policy Adherence:** Ensure internal clients understand and adhere to venue usage guidelines and institutional space-use policies.

**2. Event Planning & Cross-Departmental Coordination (40%)**

* **Lifecycle Logistics:** Manage the end-to-end logistics for assigned portfolio events (e.g., University Club at Edgewood Series, Groundbreaking Ceremonies, Grand Openings/Ribbon Cuttings).

* **PR & Marketing Liaison**: Collaborate with Public Relations and Marketing Communications (PRMC) teams for the design and production of event signage, digital/print invitations, and collateral.
* **Registration & Guest Data:** Build and manage digital RSVP pages. Oversee data intake, track guest lists, manage seating charts, and compile dietary restrictions for catering teams.
* **Institutional Protocol**: Ensure all event logistics align with university traditions, branding guidelines, and presidential protocol.
* **On-Site Operations:** Lead setup, vendor arrivals (catering, rentals), registration desk operations, guest flow, and post-event breakdown to ensure institutional quality standards are met.
* **Volunteer Oversight**: Direct and supervise student assistants/volunteers assigned to event tasks on-site, ensuring adherence to department guidelines and professionalism.
* **Feedback Collection:** Manage the onsite distribution and collection of physical & digital survey instruments and feedback tools to capture attendee data.
* **Expense Tracking:** Monitor individual event budgets, log expenditures, and maintain meticulous spending records to ensure events stay within assigned fiscal parameters.
* **Financial Processing:** Facilitate vendor invoices, purchase orders, and payment processing, assisting with the final reconciliation process.

**3. Departmental Support (10%)**

* **All-Hands Initiatives:** Assist with large-scale, all-hands department initiatives (e.g., Commencement, Convocation, etc.) as needed.
* **General Support:** Provide comprehensive operational support to the department as directed by leadership.
* **Other Duties**: Perform other duties as assigned by department leadership.

**Responsibilities include:**

The Media Coordinator supports the planning, execution, monitoring and reporting of paid media programs across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients. Working closely with the Senior Media Manager, Media Director and specialized media partners, this role helps ensure campaigns are launched accurately, monitored consistently and managed according to client objectives, budgets and timelines.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data, managing details and deadlines, communicating with internal and external partners, and learning how different media channels work together to achieve client goals.

* Monitor and analyze paid media performance and assist with monthly client reporting.

SpendHQ is a fast-growing and dynamic Procuretech Scale-up with an incredible collaborative company culture. But we are not stopping here. SpendHQ is taking on new challenges and we look forward to continuing to grow the company and team.  
  
  
**Where would you fit in the team?**  
  
The Strategic Account Manager role focuses on strengthening relationships with key accounts, driving value through SpendHQ’s solutions. It involves collaborating with senior stakeholders to develop long-term strategies, driving revenue growth, ensuring client retention, and managing complex sales processes. The role also influences product strategy to meet client needs.  
  
**What will your job entail?**

* Manage and strengthen relationships with strategic accounts, aligning SpendHQ solutions with client objectives.

* You have excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with prospects and clients.

**Why do people love working at SpendHQ?**

* Bold in Action – We believe in taking daring moves. We do everything with enthusiasm because we know our work is meaningful.

Salary commensurate with experience. This is a full-time, salaried position with a competitive benefits package:

* Parental leave

* Health insurance
* Performance bonus

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other protected status. jobs.description:
**ESSENTIAL PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION**

The Inside Sales Account Manager serves as the primary inside-sales contact for assigned customers and supports Regional Sales Managers throughout the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process. The role drives revenue growth, customer retention, and operational efficiency by identifying sales and upsell opportunities, interpreting technical requirements, managing pricing and quotations, coordinating follow-up, resolving issues, supporting training, and managing customer projects. In the wire and cable manufacturing industry, where product complexity, lead times, and customer specifications are critical, the Inside Sales Account Manager uses CRM data and a consultative approach to anticipate customer needs, coordinate internal resources, fulfill commitments, and build strong relationships at all organizational levels.

Success in this position is measured through profitable revenue growth, customer retention, quotation responsiveness, opportunity conversion, CRM data quality, timely issue resolution, and effective coordination with sales and cross-functional partners.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Reporting to the Sales Operations Manager, the Inside Sales Account Manager owns inside-sales responsibilities for assigned key accounts. These accounts may have a history of generating significant revenue, demonstrate strong revenue potential, or hold strategic importance to the business.

* Develop account-penetration strategies for assigned target and competitive accounts to retain and expand existing business, win new business, and maintain a balanced sales opportunity funnel.
* Analyze and prepare bids and requests for quotation in accordance with established guidelines. Evaluate inventory availability, market intelligence, competitive position, price validity, logistics, and fulfillment requirements. Partner with the Business Value Manager to support pricing decisions that maximize profitability, market share, and customer value.
* Maintain an accurate opportunity funnel, complete timely follow-up to advance and close opportunities, and analyze win-loss results to identify trends and improve future sales activity.
* Maintain complete and timely records of customer interactions, quotations, and follow-up activities in HubSpot CRM. Monitor deal stages, create and complete tasks, and manage pipelines to support consistent customer engagement and accurate reporting. Identify CRM workflow or automation improvements that strengthen visibility and follow-up.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for pricing, product recommendations, policy application, sample requests, inventory availability, lead times, order status, and value-added support. Coordinate with internal subject-matter experts as needed.
* Provide responsive support before, during, and after the sale. Monitor order fulfillment, identify service risks, and coordinate resolution of nonconformances and other customer issues with the appropriate internal teams.
* Build and maintain product, application, and industry knowledge; translate product features and benefits into solutions aligned with customer needs; and participate in relevant product and sales training.
* Manage manufacturer representatives within the assigned territory by establishing communication routines, providing product and process training, supporting account activity, and monitoring follow-through.
* Contribute customer, market, pipeline, and competitive insights to territory business planning, and participate in trade shows, customer visits, and sales meetings with manufacturer representatives or Regional Sales Managers as requested.
* Respond to customer inquiries accurately, promptly, and professionally. When an immediate resolution is not available, communicate status, ownership, and next steps to internal and external stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or marketing discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least two years of inside sales, account management, or direct customer-selling experience, preferably in an industrial or business-to-business manufacturing environment. Experience should include opportunity development, consultative selling, negotiation, follow-up, and closing sales.
* At least one year of experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or an equivalent CRM to support sales operations in a manufacturing or industrial business-to-business environment.

**PREFERRED LICENSES OR CERTIFICATIONS**

* Preferred certifications include HubSpot Sales Software, Marketing Software, CRM Implementation, or comparable CRM credentials.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED**

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing customer and business needs, make sound independent judgments within established guidelines, and escalate decisions when appropriate.
* Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with customers, manufacturer representatives, and internal partners at all organizational levels.
* Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret CRM data, identify sales and customer-retention trends, and recommend actions based on the findings.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Pricing, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, and Customer Service to move quotations, orders, and customer issues to resolution.
* Working knowledge of the requirements and challenges of manufacturer representatives, utilities, electrical distributors, engineers, and end users.
* Ability to develop working knowledge of the electrical industry, the company’s product portfolio, and the applications and customer requirements relevant to assigned accounts.

* Develop and execute integrated digital marketing strategies and campaigns across web, email, social media, search, and other digital channels.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adapt to changing needs.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable interacting with employees, clients, vendors, and visitors.

### **What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **organized, personable, resourceful, and dependable**; someone who naturally notices what needs to be done and takes initiative to get it done.

From welcoming a visitor and helping them find the right person, to making sure the office is stocked, mail is handled, and team events are organized, this role is an important part of creating a professional and enjoyable workplace.

If you enjoy being the person others can count on and take pride in keeping an office running smoothly, **we'd love to hear from you.**

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Sales/Group Coordinator is responsible for managing and coordinating group bookings and sales for the airline. This role involves working closely with corporate clients, travel agents, and group organizers to arrange and manage group travel, ensuring seamless communication between all parties. The coordinator assists with negotiating rates, managing bookings, processing payments, and ensuring that all travel arrangements meet client needs. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience in sales or group travel coordination. jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Build and own logistics at Planture US.** Planture is looking for a hands-on Logistics Coordinator to take ownership of logistics for our US office. You’ll be the first person in this role, with the opportunity to shape how the function works and build a strong domestic logistics network as our business grows and have close connections with our HQ office in Amsterdam.

This is a role for someone who enjoys keeping shipments moving, staying on top of contracts and schedules, and stepping in when plans change. Logistics can be unpredictable, so you’ll need to be comfortable solving problems quickly while keeping customers and colleagues informed.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate imports through our customer broker, including customs clearance, drayage and delivery to external warehouses.
* Coordinate outbound shipments from our warehouses to customers.
* Organize, monitor and administratively process import orders.
* Track delivery schedules, transport status and logistics positions, and act quickly when something is delayed or at risk.
* Manage logistics contracts and service agreements, keeping terms, rates and performance under review.
* Stay in regular contact with brokers, carriers, warehouses, logistics department in Amsterdam and other logistics partners.
* Request, compare and negotiate transportation rates and service agreements.
* Act as the link between logistics partners, customers and Planture’s commercial team.
* Help the commercial team provide customers with clear, timely updates and practical solutions.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve logistics processes and systems.
* Build and develop Planture’s network of domestic logistics partners.

**What we’re looking for**

You’re an independent and organized logistics professional who takes ownership and enjoys making things work. You can keep track of the details while also seeing where a process can be improved. When a shipment runs into trouble, you stay calm, communicate clearly and focus on the next steps.

**You’ll bring:**

* Around two years of relevant logistics experience.
* Experience with international logistics and order fulfilment.
* Knowledge of customs clearance and import procedures; experience with US imports is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills and close attention to detail.
* A structured, accurate and well-organized way of working.
* Clear communication skills and confidence dealing with customers and external partners.
* A commercial, solution-focused mindset.
* The ability to work independently, set priorities and take ownership.
* Availability to work five days per week.

**What we offer:**

* The opportunity to take ownership of logistics at Planture US and build the function as it grows.
* A broad, hands-on role with direct involvement in logistics decisions, partner relationships, customer support and process improvements.
* Close collaboration with Planture’s commercial team and logistics partners.
* Salary between $40.000 - $80.000 depending on relevant experience

**Why join Planture?**

You’ll have a direct impact on Planture’s day-to-day logistics operations. You won’t just process orders: you’ll help shape transportation decisions, manage logistics partners and contracts, support customers and improve the way logistics works across the US business.

If you’re ready to take responsibility, solve real-world logistics challenges and build something from the ground up, we’d like to hear from you.

Pay: $40,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Finance & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Grant Park Music Festival is Chicago’s summer music festival, bringing world-class orchestral and choral performances to Millennium Park and neighborhoods throughout the city. For more than nine decades, the Festival has made exceptional classical music accessible to everyone, presenting free concerts in one of Chicago’s most iconic public spaces while building connections with audiences and communities across the city.
  
  
The Festival is seeking a full-time Finance and Administrative Coordinator to join our mission-driven, collaborative team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, resourceful, and proactive administrator who enjoys working across functions and wants to play an important role in the day-to-day operations of a dynamic nonprofit arts organization.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Financial and Administrative Officer, this position helps ensure that financial processes are accurate and timely, leadership and board activities are well coordinated, and the Festival’s office operates smoothly and efficiently. The Finance and Administrative Coordinator will join a team of 17 year-round staff members dedicated to enriching lives through the power of music.
  
  
In this small and highly collaborative organization, the Coordinator will work closely with Festival leadership and staff while gaining broad experience across finance, nonprofit administration, governance, and operations. The successful candidate will be someone who can manage details carefully, anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and shift comfortably among financial, administrative, operational, and technology-related responsibilities.
  
  
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Finance
  
  

* Process accounts payable and accounts and pledges receivable transactions in accordance with established procedures.
* Record deposits in the general ledger and maintain accurate revenue reports.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain corporate credit card records and reconcile monthly statements.
* Support the annual budgeting and quarterly re-projection processes.

Executive and Board Support
  
  

* Provide administrative and organizational support to the President & CEO, including calendar and meeting coordination, correspondence and materials, travel arrangements, and meeting notes.
* Coordinate logistics for Board of Directors and committee meetings, including scheduling, materials distribution, meeting setup, notetaking, and preparation of formal minutes.
* Coordinate all-staff events, professional development activities, retreats, meetings, and staff recognition.

Office, Facilities, and Technology
  
  

* Serve as a liaison with building management, security, and maintenance to support an effective and well-functioning Festival office.
* Manage office supplies, shared equipment, storage areas, and day-to-day office needs.
* Serve as the primary liaison to the Festival’s outsourced IT services provider and coordinate day-to-day office technology, including hardware, software, cloud files, copiers, printers, and phone systems.
* Provide basic technology training and troubleshooting for staff.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, postage, and office access systems.
* Serve as a welcoming first point of contact for visitors, callers, vendors, and constituents.
* Obtain vendor bids and support procurement decisions by comparing pricing, terms, and service levels; negotiate routine vendor terms within established organizational guidelines.

The position also supports seasonal staff onboarding and offboarding, HR recordkeeping, research, mailings, special projects, and other administrative needs at the Festival.
  
  
MINIMUM CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* At least 2 years of relevant administrative, finance, operations, and/or nonprofit experience.
* At least 1 year of experience with accounts payable, accounts and pledges receivable, account reconciliations, and other general accounting functions.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential financial, personnel, donor, board, and organizational information with discretion.
* Strong computer skills and comfort learning and supporting a range of office technology and software systems, including Microsoft 365 applications.
* Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, identify and resolve routine problems, and know when to seek guidance.
* A collaborative, flexible approach and willingness to contribute wherever needed in a small, fast-moving nonprofit environment.
* Experience in a nonprofit performing arts organization is preferred, but not required.
* Don’t fit all of the qualifications listed above, but feel passionate about the position? Please apply anyway! We are eager to work with enthusiastic and ambitious people. You may be just the right fit for this role.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
  
  

* $49,000 - $57,000, commensurate with experience.
* Annual benefits package includes 10 days paid vacation, 11 paid holidays, 4 paid personal days, and 12 paid sick days.
* Health insurance for employee and dependents (75% employer paid); dental and vision insurance (25% employer paid); employer-paid life insurance.
* 403(b) retirement plan with 3.75% employer match after one year of employment.
* Complimentary reserved seating for friends and family at Festival performances, steeply discounted staff parking at the Millennium Park Garage, opportunities for free/discounted tickets to partner performances/shows at venues across Chicago.

SCHEDULE & WORK LOCATION
  
  

* This role is based in the Festival’s Chicago office at 205 E. Randolph St, within the Harris Theater at the northern edge of Millennium Park.
* The typical work day is 9am - 5:00pm, with longer days sometimes necessary at certain times of

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **Part-Time | $28/hour | Approximately 25 hours/week**

Flexible/Hybrid | Uptown, Chicago | Local Travel Required

The Selfhelp Home is a not-for-profit Continuing Care Retirement Community serving older adults for more than 85 years. Our campus includes Independent Living, Assisted Living, and a 5-star Medicare-certified Skilled Nursing Facility. We are rooted in Jewish values and welcome residents of all backgrounds.

We are seeking an outgoing and relationship-driven Community Outreach Coordinator to build community partnerships, increase awareness of Selfhelp, and develop referral opportunities throughout Chicago and surrounding communities.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Build relationships with synagogues, Jewish organizations, healthcare providers, seniorservice organizations, and community partners.
* Represent Selfhelp at community events, senior fairs, networking events, and presentations.
* Develop referral relationships with hospitals, physicians, social workers, discharge planners, hospice, home care, and other healthcare partners.
* Coordinate community outreach events and volunteer opportunities.
* Support marketing and community engagement initiatives.
* Track outreach activities, referrals, leads, and followups in the CRM.
* Assist with promoting Selfhelp's history, programs, and community initiatives.

#### **Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, relationshipbased sales, volunteer coordination, or program development.
* Experience in senior living, healthcare, nonprofit, or Jewish community organizations preferred.
* Strong relationshipbuilding, communication, and publicspeaking skills.
* Organized, selfmotivated, and comfortable working independently.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable using CRM systems.
* Reliable transportation for local travel; mileage reimbursed.
* Availability for occasional evening and weekend events.

This is a part-time position with the potential to grow into a full-time role as the outreach program expands.

The Selfhelp Home is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

#### **About THE SELFHELP HOME**

The Selfhelp Home is a not-for-profit Jewish retirement community on the north side of Chicago with a tradition of caring that is celebrating over 70 years. Selfhelp ranks at the top nationwide for nursing care and maintains the highest possible star rating with Medicare and we are Accredited by The Joint Commission. Selfhelp was awarded Best Nursing Homes and Best Short-Term Stays by US News and World Report, in 2023 and for the past consecutive 9 years.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator Nurse- Full-Time Days (Bronzeville)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**

The **Operations Coordinator Nurse**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Under the clinical direction of the Medical Director and the administrative direction of the Practice Manager, the Operations Coordinator, Nurse participates in the planning, leading, and organizing of activities relating to quality patient care in the practice. S/he supervises and personally provides nursing care in the practice.

The Operations Coordinator Nurse will be responsible for supervising the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising clinical and administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, manage practice collections, ensure service excellence and perform service recovery as necessary.

Position manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks. Responsible for front-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity. Position may perform staff work in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.

**Responsibilities:**

* Supervise and direct the office’s front-line clinical and clerical staff for different departments including Oncology, Women's Health, Neurologoly, Dermotology.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
* Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
* Assist with managing providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
* Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co-pays and patient balances, in-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
* Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
* Manage office and medical surgical supplies within budget
* Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
* Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis.
* Attend and actively participate in manager/supervisor meetings.
* Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.
* Additional Functions
  + Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
  + Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
  + Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one to one coaching and mentoring.
  + Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc)
  + Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with procedures.
  + Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
  + Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost-savings, and operational efficiencies.
  + Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed to support the practice.
  + Complete other duties as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of three years work experience in a medical or related business
* Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO,PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, Medicaid
* Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office
* Leadership experience
* Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel
* Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.
* Current License as Registered Professional Nurse in state employed in.
* CPR

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Knowledge of coding
* Supervisory experience

  
**Additional Information**

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

jobs.title: Meeting & Events Coordinator - Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
**Ready to take your career to the next level? Join our top tier Workplace Experience Host Team at CBRE, where you'll collaborate with a diverse group of associates to provide white glove hospitality to employees and clients, creating a wonderful workplace environment and daily experience**

**About The Role:**

As a CBRE Meeting and Events Coordinator, you will assist with the detailing and operation of meetings, conferences, and events. This job is part of the Events job function.

This role is onsite in Chicago, IL USA.

**What You'll Do:**

* Detail meetings and events with clients – floor plans, timelines, vendors, AV needs, etc. – for a small conference center and an outdoor event space. Events range from corporate meetings to outdoor weddings.
* Support day-of event operations, including gathering supplies, coordinating equipment needs, and responding to onsite requests.
* Act as the on-site contact for meetings and events, delivering a hospitable, world-class experience for attendees, event owners, and vendors.

* Assist with post-event reporting and reconciliation. Raise potential issues and concerns
* Create marketing materials and event communications to promote meetings, events, and tenant engagement initiatives.
* Brainstorm and help develop creative tenant engagement events and experiences throughout the year.
* Manage the backend of the building’s tenant app, including updating content, publishing event information, and maintaining accurate, timely communications as appropriate.
* Maintain documentation of small-space configurations, décor options, and event-related items. Manage and organize event supply inventory.
* Complete regular room checks and ensure technical and visual spaces are functional.
* Along with other Event team members, plan and execute indoor and outdoor building tenant events throughout the year. Includes building vendor relationships, some design and marketing, budgeting.
* Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.
* Responsibilities and processes are clearly defined, with limited discretion required.
* Complete assigned responsibilities by following established procedures under guidance from leadership.
* Work a flexible schedule based on scheduled indoor/outdoor event needs, which vary week to week, but generally are Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Planning ahead – being prepared for the expected and unexpected.
* Consistently accurate event execution with minimal day-of issues.
* Positive feedback from clients on your communication and service.
* Taking ownership and pride of the event spaces and inventories.
* Suggesting and implementing improvements to existing processes to improve efficiency.

**What You'll Need:**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* High School Diploma or GED required, Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Prior work experience in event, hospitality, customer service, or related field required.
* Fulfill the physical requirements associated with this role. This includes stooping, standing, walking, and climbing stairs. Should be able to occasionally lift/carry heavy loads up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
* Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
* Working knowledge of virtual meeting/event platforms (Teams, Zoom). Ability to troubleshoot audio/visual and technical issues with clients (training provided).
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong organizational skills.

**Who This Role Is Great For:**

* Someone who enjoys both planning and hands-on execution
* Someone with a hospitality or customer-first mindset.
* Someone looking to learn the role, then take ownership of it.

**Why CBRE?**

We value a culture of respect, integrity, service and excellence that crafts our approach to every opportunity! We are guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build, and the world we thrive in.

Competitive pay and benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, 401k, and more that start 1st of the month. Internal advancement available after 6-month mark.

FORTUNE Most Admired Company #1 in real estate for third consecutive year; Ten years in a row on the list.

Forbes Named one of the best large employers in America and one of the World's Best Employers!

**Disclaimers**

**Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.**

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Meeting & Events Coordinator position is $60,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Meeting & Events Coordinator position is $67,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

jobs.title: Events & Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Events & Communications Specialist serves as a key member of the Development Team and plays a central role in coordinating fundraising events, implementing communications strategies, and managing a variety of development projects and administrative functions.

This position is responsible for coordinating special events and donor engagement opportunities, executing communications across digital platforms, maintaining development materials and ensuring the successful implementation of development initiatives. The Events & Communications Specialist works closely with the Executive Director, the Development Director, the Development Operations & Donor Relations Manager, the Grants, Institutional Giving & Impact Manager, and the Strategic Communications Consultant to support the organization's fundraising, stewardship, communications, and engagement goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with strong project management skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Events Management & Engagement**

* Coordinate and execute fundraising, stewardship, volunteer, and community engagement events, including Friendsfest, board-hosted events, cultivation gatherings, volunteer activities, and other organizational events.
* Develop and manage event timelines, project plans, and logistics to ensure successful event execution.
* Coordinate event registration, guest management, volunteer recruitment, vendor relationships, venue logistics, catering, transportation, supplies, and event materials.
* Manage event budgets, timelines, and operational plans in partnership with the Development Director.
* Coordinate and oversee in-kind donations for events and campaigns, ensuring all product needs are secured and fulfilled, in collaboration with the Director of Development and Executive Director.
* Coordinate pre- and post-event communications and materials in collaboration (leadership briefings, attendee communications, etc.) with the development team.
* Support event sponsorship fulfillment and donor stewardship activities associated with fundraising events.
* Coordinate event follow-up activities, reporting, and evaluation to assess effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support site visits and engagement opportunities for donors, funders, board members, corporate partners, and community stakeholders as needed in collaboration with other team members.
* Coordinate volunteer recruitment, communications, scheduling, and engagement for development-related activities and events.

**Communications Implementation & Digital Channels**

* Implement communications plans developed by organizational leadership and communications partners.

jobs.title: Sporting Goods Event Coordinator - Account Executive Chicago
jobs.description:
**Your Mission**  
Be the face of SidelineSwap in your region. You'll run pop-up trade-in events at partner retail stores, buy high-quality used gear from athletes and sports families, and manage your own SidelineSwap business account where that gear gets resold.

**What You'll Do**  
You'll split your time between two things: running weekend trade-in events and managing your online store.

On the event side, you'll build relationships with the retail partners hosting your events, evaluate and buy used sports gear using our trade-in software, deliver a great customer experience, and handle the logistics of getting gear photographed and shipped back to our warehouse. Most of your event schedule is planned for you — and as you get comfortable, you'll have opportunities to build your own partnerships and expand your buying beyond events.

On the account side, you'll run your own SidelineSwap business unit. That means reviewing performance metrics, managing inventory, responding to customers, and making smart pricing decisions to maximize your sales and monthly bonus.

**What We're Looking For**

* A hustler's mindset — you treat this like your own business, not just a job
* Strong customer service instincts and comfort talking to anyone
* Entrepreneurial experience or a side hustle is a big plus
* General sports knowledge; expertise in one sport preferred
Comfort working independently in a remote, non-traditional schedule  

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary plus monthly performance bonuses
* Health and dental benefits
* Equity in SidelineSwap
Real opportunity for growth as we expand the team  

**Schedule**  
This is not a Monday–Friday, 9-to-5 role. Events run Friday through Sunday at partner retail locations. Wednesday and Thursday are work-from-home days for account management and event prep. Monday and Tuesday off.

**About SidelineSwap**  
SidelineSwap is the #1 online marketplace for sports gear. Since launching in 2015, over two million athletes and sports families have joined our community to buy and sell equipment. We recently partnered with Dick's Sporting Goods and other leading retailers to power the circular economy in sports through our trade-in program — making it easier and more affordable for families to play the sports they love.

We're a small, fully remote team that operates with a lot of autonomy and a collaborative mindset. Named one of the fastest-growing marketplaces on the a16z Marketplace 100.

**Schedule: Full Time**

**Job Type: Hybrid**

**Req #: 3331**

The **Strategic Account Manager (SAM) — LTL SME** owns the ultimate health, retention, strategic growth, and overall performance of assigned accounts, serving as the primary authority on Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) strategy and network optimization.

While relying on Operations Account Managers (OAMs) and execution teams for daily freight movement, the SAM remains fully accountable for program outcomes. This role bridges the gap between high-level account strategy and operational execution—partnering closely with LTL Procurement and mixed TL/LTL operations teams to drive cost savings, service excellence, and value delivery across the customer's network.

### **Core Responsibilities & Execution Pillars**

#### **1. LTL Program Management & Strategic Optimization**

* **Network & Strategy Alignment:** Drive overarching LTL strategy across procurement and operations, acting as the subject-matter expert to align daily execution with macro account goals.
* **Deep-Dive Analytics:** Perform deep-dive program analyses to identify cost, service, and efficiency insights; translate raw data into actionable strategic initiatives (e.g., mode conversions, lane optimization, pooling, and drop trailer strategies).
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify process gaps, evaluate broader market dynamics, and champion LTL best practices across the account team.

#### **2. Governance, Financial Oversight & Tech Management**

* **Financial & Margin Management:** Review margins, monitor DTO queues, and analyze accessorial trends to eliminate avoidable costs and drive profitability.
* **Network Health Governance:** Monitor systemic operational issues (e.g., chronic offender carriers or troubled lanes) to resolve root-cause delays and missed pickups.
* **Tech Management:** Direct tech escalations, manage user access requests, and oversee EDI/API integrations and UAT testing to ensure seamless platform operations.

#### **3. Executive Customer Engagement & Value Delivery**

* **Value Proposition Ownership:** Ensure program value propositions are consistently communicated, validated, and delivered across all customer touchpoints.
* **Business Reviews (MBR/QBR):** Build high-impact presentation materials and lead Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews to showcase performance, key wins, and forward-looking strategic initiatives.
* **Relationship Expansion:** Strengthen executive-level relationships, engage new stakeholders, and position the company as an indispensable strategic partner.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5-7+ years of experience driving LTL account strategy, mode conversions, and laneoptimization within an account management or related role.
* Prior experience working with enterprise accounts or accounts with Freight Spend of 20M +
* Experience Leading MBRs/QBRs, managing executive stakeholder relationships, and delivering customer value.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience analyzing operational and financial data to uncover cost savings and efficiency gains.
* Has managed account margins, tracking accessorials, and resolving systemic operational issues.
* Overseeing EDI/API integrations, UAT testing, and system escalations.
* Prior experience working directly for an LTL Carrier or related company.
* Proficient with MS Excel, Power BI, and Salesforce.

  

**Benefits & Compensation for U.S. Employees**

Employees working more than 30 hours in the US at Uber Freight are eligible for benefits like a company sponsored health plan, dental and vision benefits, 401k match, financial and mental wellness benefits, parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance and more. US based employees may also be eligible for a performance or sales incentive bonus program, participation in Uber Freight equity awards, and other types of compensation depending upon the role.

**About Uber Freight**

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. We bring together the technology, people, and transportation capacity they need, using real‑time data from millions of shipments to guide smarter decisions. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. Learn more at www.uberfreight.com.

jobs.title: Program Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  

Job Overview:

As a Program Operations Specialist for the Business Transformation team, you’ll be responsible for keeping the programs, day-to-day machinery, and planning ecosystem running so that business leaders can focus on managing risks and making decisions. This role supports calendaring, project plan updates, documentation of meeting transcripts and working files, developing AI agent-based reporting, and coordinating cross-functional meetings.

This hybrid position may report to our corporate office in either downtown Chicago, Illinois; Hoffman Estates, Illinois; or Dania Beach, Florida. This role requires monthly travel FirstService Residential corporate offices in the United States and Canada.

Your Responsibilities:

* Schedule and coordinate workstream sessions, steering committees, support the planning and documentation of configuration workshops, and counterpart meetings across four organizations and multiple time zones; hold broad calendar awareness across workstreams and coordinate availability.
* Prepare agendas and pre-reads, confirm attendance and counterparts, manage room and virtual logistics, and distribute follow-ups and draft documents via Co-Pilot and Claude.
* Ensure every working and decision-making meeting is transcribed, and that raw transcripts and summaries land in the designated Teams folder using the agreed naming and folder structure.
* Review transcripts and summaries for decisions, actions and risks; draft entries for the Decisions Log and Risk Log and route them to the owning lead for confirmation; track open actions to closure.
* Maintain the master project plan in Smartsheet with the Program Manager: status updates from pillar leads, date changes, new rows from partner plans, and reconciliation against the pillar action plans; track overdue items and flag conflicts before they reach the weekly report.
* Keep Confluence current as the long-term document repository (design objects, RACI, counterpart matrix, process documentation) and Teams as the collaboration space; maintain the program glossary and distribution lists.
* Support the weekly reporting cycle by assembling inputs and verifying them against the plan and logs.
* Serve as the logistics point of contact across multiple teams and partners, coordinate onboarding, access requests and document exchange (SharePoint/SFTP) for partner staff.
* Support UAT and training logistics as the program moves into build: tester rosters, session scheduling around business blackouts, script and issue-log housekeeping.

Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in executive administration, project management, operations, or coordinator roles.
* Experience with process mapping tools, workflow automation, and project management methodologies required. Experience with Smartsheet or similar project management tools strongly preferred.
* Works effectively with coworkers, clients, customers, and others by sharing ideas in a constructive and positive manner; addresses problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions.
* Must possess a high energy attitude and an ability to multi-task/prioritize different projects at any given time.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

What We Offer:

As a full-time associate, you will be eligible for full comprehensive benefits including your choice of multiple medical plans, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance. You will also be eligible for company-paid life insurance and benefits from our employee assistance program. In addition, you will be eligible for paid time off, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) with company match.

Compensation:

$ 65000 - $ 75,000 / hour

Disclaimer Statement

The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. This is not an all-inclusive job description; therefore, management has the right to assign or reassign schedules, duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

  
  
**Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) Usage:** We may utilize an Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) in connection with the assessment or evaluation of candidates. The AEDT is designed to assist in objectively evaluating candidate qualifications based on specific job-related characteristics.  
  
**Job Qualifications and Characteristics Assessed:** The AEDT evaluates candidates based on job qualifications and characteristics pertinent to the role, including skills, experience, and competencies relevant to the position requirements. These qualifications are determined by the unique needs of each role within our company.  
  
**Alternative Selection Process or Reasonable Accommodations:** Candidates who require an alternative selection process or a “reasonable accommodation,” as defined under applicable disability laws, may make a request through our designated contact channel national\_recruiting@fsresidential.com.
