jobs.title: Client Experience & Wellness Concierge (formerly Freeze & Float)
jobs.description:
***Nuva Haus*** *formerly Freeze & Float · River North, Chicago, IL*

***About Nuva Haus***

Nuva Haus is Chicago's destination for longevity and advanced wellness — a modern, considered space in River North where science-backed treatments meet genuine hospitality. We offer hormone optimization, peptide therapy, IV drips, aesthetics, and recovery modalities designed to help clients feel and perform at their best.

We're building a team that takes the client experience as seriously as the clinical one. That means every touchpoint — from the first call to the final follow-up — should feel intentional, warm, and exceptional.

***The Role***

This is a front-of-house role with real ownership. As our Client Experience & Wellness Concierge, you are the connective tissue of Nuva Haus — the person who makes clients feel known, supported, and excited to come back. You will work across every service line, build lasting relationships with our client base, and play a direct role in the growth and retention of the practice.

This is not a passive desk role. The right person is curious about wellness, energized by human connection, and brings a hospitality mindset to every interaction — whether that's greeting a new client, following up after a treatment, or helping someone understand which protocol is right for them.

***What You Will Own***

*Client Relationship & Retention*

* Greet every client with genuine warmth — remember names, preferences, and treatment history
* Drive rebooking and retention through personalized follow-up calls, texts, and progress check-ins
* Build long-term client relationships that support wellness goals and membership growth

*Clinic Coordination & Flow*

* Prepare guests for services including IV drips, injections, aesthetics, and recovery therapies
* Coordinate appointments and manage day-of scheduling with precision and calm
* Support room turnover, setup, and clinic cleanliness standards

*Client Education & Sales Support*

* Educate clients on our full service menu, wellness protocols, and membership offerings (full training provided)
* Make thoughtful product and service recommendations aligned to each client's goals
* Contribute to a culture of excellence, continuous learning, and team performance

***Who You Are***

* You have a genuine enthusiasm for wellness, longevity, or health optimization — and you bring that energy to every conversation
* You are warm, professional, and instinctively hospitable — clients leave your interactions feeling taken care of
* You are organized, reliable, and calm under pressure in a fast-moving clinical environment
* You can hold a real conversation about treatments like NAD+, IV therapy, peptide protocols, and aesthetics — or you're highly motivated to learn
* Experience in wellness, medspa, aesthetics, hospitality, or client services is a strong advantage — not a requirement
* A licensed esthetician or medical assistant background is a plus, not a prerequisite

*We will train the right person. What we can't train is genuine care, professional presence, and the instinct to make every client feel like a priority.*

***Compensation & Benefits***

* **Pay:** $21–$30 per hour, based on experience
* **Bonus:** Commission structure and client retention bonuses available
* **Discounts:** Generous staff discounts on services and wellness products
* **Schedule:** Full-time and part-time available · Weekend rotation required
* **Training:** Ongoing access to cutting-edge treatments and professional development
* **Environment:** Beautiful, modern wellness space in River North with a supportive, growth-oriented team
* **Health Insurance:** Explored at the 6-month milestone for eligible team members

***How to Apply***

Send your resume and a brief note — not a form cover letter — to jobs@nuvahaus.com. Tell us: what draws you to the intersection of wellness and client experience, and what kind of impression you want to leave on the people you work with every day.

LinkedIn profiles welcome. We read everything we receive.

*Nuva Haus · River North, Chicago IL 60654 · In-Person Role*

Pay: $21.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* On-the-job training

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Personal & Executive Assistant / Lifestyle Coordinator — Chicago
jobs.description:
**Personal & Executive Assistant / Lifestyle Coordinator — Chicago**

We are looking for an exceptional, highly organized and proactive personal assistant to support two busy professionals in Chicago.

This is not a housekeeping role. We are looking for someone who can become the organizational center of our lives — helping us manage schedules, travel, social commitments, personal projects and several new business ventures while making everything run more smoothly and efficiently.

The ideal person is someone who genuinely loves organization, thinks ahead, solves problems quickly and enjoys creating systems that make busy lives easier.

**Responsibilities may include:**

* Managing calendars, appointments and daily schedules
* Coordinating flights, hotels, transportation and travel itineraries
* Organizing social plans, dinners, events and reservations
* Helping coordinate new business projects and keeping projects moving
* Researching vendors, services, purchases and opportunities
* Managing personal appointments and reminders
* Helping organize our weeks so our time is used more effectively
* Creating and maintaining to-do lists, project trackers and follow-up systems
* Coordinating our cleaning lady and other service providers
* Managing deliveries, packages, returns and occasional errands
* Coordinating plant care and other basic household needs
* Assisting with social media planning, content coordination and scheduling where appropriate
* Helping prepare for travel before we leave and keeping things organized while we are away
* Making sure important tasks do not fall through the cracks
* Generally looking for ways to make our personal and professional lives easier and more efficient

There will be a mixture of personal, social and business responsibilities, so discretion and good judgment are extremely important.

We are looking for someone who can eventually understand our routines and anticipate what needs to happen without needing constant direction.

**You might be a great fit if you are:**

* Extremely organized
* Proactive and resourceful
* Warm, personable and easy to work with
* Naturally good at planning and logistics
* Excellent at communicating by text, email and phone
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities at once
* Tech-savvy and comfortable with calendars, travel apps, spreadsheets and organizational tools
* Good at researching and presenting options
* Comfortable communicating with vendors and service providers
* Discreet and trustworthy
* Flexible when plans change
* Someone who enjoys figuring things out rather than waiting to be told every next step

Previous experience as a personal assistant, executive assistant, lifestyle assistant, project coordinator, hospitality professional or similar role is preferred.

Experience with social media, event planning, travel coordination or startup/new-business environments would be a strong plus.

**Location:** Chicago  
**Schedule:** Approximately 15–20 hours per week  
**Compensation:** $25/hour

Some work can be handled remotely, but we want someone based in Chicago who can also be physically present when needed.

This role has the potential to become an important long-term position for the right person. We are looking for someone who wants to truly learn our lives, help us build better systems and become a trusted right hand to both of us.

**To apply:**

Please send your resume along with a short introduction telling us:

* Why this type of role appeals to you
* The most complicated personal or professional schedule you have managed
* An example of something you organized or improved without being asked
* Your availability

Professional references and a background check will be required.

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60640

At Shef, we are bringing weekly personal chef services to busy families in a convenient and affordable format. We believe in providing amateur and professional chefs an opportunity to grow their own meal delivery businesses and make a meaningful income by doing what they love! We are looking for an operationally-minded teammate to execute on the day-to-day on-the-ground operations. You will ensure deliveries safely make their way from chefs to consumers and serve as the face of Shef to chefs (“shefs”) in our markets. The ideal candidate is an excellent executor and communicator, and is passionate about bringing delicious, authentic food to their local market!

* Ensure clean receipt of deliveries from shefs, and execute on sending deliveries off with third-party logistics providers
* Innovate, test, and measure success of operational efficiency initiatives - create SOPs for initiatives that prove positive enough to become a national standard and help roll-out such initiatives across the country

**Production Coordinator**

**Company:** PALY Hollywood  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (on-site)  
**Reports to:** Production Manager  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment:** Full-time

**ABOUT PALY**

PALY embodies the act of storytelling. Through the release of seasonal collections, the brand explores a range of subjects, with an emphasis on Hollywood history, infamous crimes, conspiracies, drug tales, and the cult phenomenon.

Rooted in carefully referenced alternative motifs, scribbled drawings, and delicate hand-worked detailing, PALY presents a vision of luxury clothing that feels authentically vintage. Each piece bears an individual, one-of-one quality. These sensibilities are reimagined through the distinctive lens of film and Hollywood iconography.

Founded in 2022 and based in Los Angeles, PALY has grown quickly across wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels, with distribution in North America, the EU, the Middle East, and Asia. We are at the stage where the brand is moving faster than the operating infrastructure beneath it.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Production Coordinator keeps production moving. The role owns the day-to-day detail behind the calendar: purchase orders, ERP entry, sample movement, follow-up with vendors, and the records that let everyone else work from accurate information.

This role is the difference between a calendar that exists on paper and one the company can trust. Accuracy and follow-through matter more here than seniority.

This is a hands-on, on-site role with real growth potential into production management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Purchase Orders & ERP Entry**

* Write and enter fabric, trim, and production purchase orders accurately and on time
* Enter and maintain style setup, cost sheets, fabric content, and country of origin in Sync
* Apply and manage UPCs for all styles moving into production
* Audit style master information before collection launch and correct errors before they move downstream
* Inactivate styles that do not move forward to sales or production
* Maintain accurate size, color, and SKU data so allocation and shipping are not working from bad information

**Calendar & WIP Support**

* Maintain the style-level WIP and update it in the ERP no less than weekly
* Track every style against its calendar milestones and flag anything slipping
* Chase vendors for confirmations, updated dates, and missing information
* Prepare the weekly production report for the Director of Production and the sales team
* Maintain the pre-production calendar and keep deadlines visible to design, development, and production

**Sample Tracking & Movement**

* Track proto, fit, salesman, TOP, and photoshoot samples from request through receipt
* Log, label, and organize samples so any style can be located on demand
* Pick up and deliver samples across factories, wash houses, printers, and the office
* Coordinate sample sets for market, trade shows, photoshoots, and PR, and confirm each set is complete before it leaves
* Follow up on outstanding samples so approvals are not the reason a date is missed

**Materials & Vendor Follow-Up**

* Track fabric, trim, and treatment orders in transit and confirm arrival against need dates
* Chase lab dips, strike-offs, and trim submits through approval
* Flag shortages and substitutions early, before they stop a cut
* Maintain vendor contact records, terms, and compliance documentation

**Receiving & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate inbound receiving between the factories, Sync, and the warehouse team
* Confirm received quantities by style, color, and size against the purchase order, and raise discrepancies
* Support invoice review by verifying that what was received matches what is billed
* Conduct on-site visits to factories and the warehouse to check quality and progress

**Quality & Records**

* Assist with quality control, including review of samples and bulk before release
* Support fit sessions by preparing samples, taking notes, and distributing comments
* Maintain detailed, organized records of production workflows, adjustments, and outcomes
* Review vendor compliance requirements per customer and check for changes quarterly

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 2+ years in apparel production, production coordination, or a closely related support role
* Working knowledge of an apparel ERP or PLM system
* Strong Excel skills
* Exceptional organization, accuracy, and follow-through
* Comfortable chasing people for answers and persistent about getting them
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for sample runs and factory visits
* Basic understanding of garment construction, fabric, and wash

**Preferred**

* Experience in luxury, contemporary, or elevated streetwear
* Experience with washed or garment-dyed product
* Working Spanish

We build mission critical parts for underwater autonomous naval vessels, moon landings, anti-missile drones and roller coaster rides, to name a few. Our engineering heavy team take on the complex builds that other shops turn away. NPI? Quick turn? We’ve got you.

Few places in the world concentrate as much space and aerospace hardware demand as El Segundo and the South Bay. It’s one of our fastest growing geographies, and that’s the territory you'll own. This is an exceptional opportunity to ride the unprecedented wave of investment and innvoation in SoCal right now.

Our ideal candidate has spent a few years in space or aerospace, in engineering, test, quality, program management, supply chain, or sales. You know how flight and defense hardware gets bought, who has a say, and what a supplier has to prove before earning a PO.

Now you want a role where your network and your initiative *are* the job. No internal politics, red tape or confused incentives- you plan your time and eat what you kill.

**What You'll Do**

* Become a known face in El Segundo's aerospace community by attending industry events, meetups, conferences, and customer sites, and following up relentlessly.
* Build your own pipeline from your network, AI-driven prospecting tools, and the phone. This is not an inside-sales seat, and there's no inherited book.
* Turn relationships into RFQs. Your core measure is qualified RFQs from new California based customers.
* Partner with BSU engineering and quality to represent our capabilities credibly to technical buyers, from program engineers to supply chain leads.
* Carry opportunities from first conversation through qualification to a quoted, PO-ready RFQ.
* Travel as needed: mostly local face time across SoCal, plus periodic trips to our Austin facility and trade shows. Expand across the west coast over time at your discretion.

**Who You Are**

* Exceptionally proactive. You don't wait for leads to show up. You walk into the room, introduce yourself, and follow up the next morning.
* Technology extrovert. You love meeting new builders and innovators and learning about their products, getting under the hood to understand what they need from their supplier and showing we’ve got it.
* In the game. 2+ years of experience in the space or aerospace industry under your belt. You already have a network in the El Segundo / South Bay aerospace community, and you're excited to keep building it.
* Sales or business development experience is a plus, not a requirement. Show us a track record of initiative, such as an idea you sold, a project you pushed through, or a goal you outworked everyone to hit.
* An engineering degree or technical training is a plus. You’re comfortable having early stage conversations about products, BOMs and build plans before it’s ready to hand over to our quoting team.
* U.S. citizenship required. No exceptions- customers often require this before you can visit their facility.

**Compensation & Ramp**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, with significant upside tied to hitting RFQ and revenue milestones.

**SYRN**

Design & Product Development Assistant

This is a fully in-office position, five days a week. (Santa Monica, CA)

**About SYRN**

SYRN is redefining modern intimates through thoughtful design, elevated essentials, and

immersive brand storytelling. Every drop, campaign, and collaboration is its own world, and

every piece we make has to live up to it. We're a fast-growing, founder-led brand where the

team runs lean, moves fast, and cares deeply about craft.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Design & Product Development Assistant who is excited to learn how product comes to life at SYRN, from first concept to production-ready piece.

You'll support our Design, Product Development, and Technical Design teams throughout the

seasonal product creation process across intimates, sleepwear, loungewear, apparel, and

accessories. You'll help bring product from initial concept through sampling, fittings, and

production handoff, supporting seasonal organization, materials, samples, PLM maintenance, vendor submissions, and day-to-day development needs.

This is an entry-level role, ideal for someone who is proactive, organized, and visually minded,

and who wants hands-on experience across both the creative and operational sides of product creation. You'll gain exposure to everything from seasonal concept development, materials, color, and assortment organization to sampling, vendor communication, fittings, PLM, and production preparation.

**What You'll Do**

- Support the Design team with day-to-day seasonal design and development needs

across intimates, sleepwear, loungewear, apparel, and accessories.

- Maintain and organize physical and digital fabric, trim, print, color, and inspiration

archives, including fabric rails and material libraries.

- Maintain the Pantone and color library, including seasonal color tracking and naming, so

standards stay organized and easily accessible.

- Assist with seasonal trend, competitive, product, color, print, fabric, trim, and inspiration

research.

- Support the creation and maintenance of seasonal Miro boards, including CAD

placement, color updates, assortment changes, and collection organization under

Design direction.

- Assist with mood boards, presentations, and seasonal design materials, and keep

artwork, print, and graphic files organized throughout development.

- Prepare samples, materials, and presentation boards for design reviews, line reviews,

and cross-functional meetings.

- Organize and track Design submissions, including fabrics, trims, prints, embroideries,

lab dips, and strike-offs.

- Support day-to-day coordination across the product development lifecycle, from initial

sampling through production handoff.

- Manage the tracking, labeling, and storage of development, fit, marketing, e-commerce,

photoshoot, and production samples.

- Receive, log, organize, and distribute incoming vendor packages and submissions, and

coordinate outgoing samples and shipments.

- Maintain physical and digital libraries for fabrics, trims, packaging, lab dips, and strike-

offs, keeping them aligned with WFX records.

- Prepare and send vendor submissions, references, samples, and development

packages, and support vendor follow-up to keep development deadlines and seasonal

milestones on track.

- Organize and maintain development and technical design documentation, including tech

packs, BOMs, spec sheets, vendor communications, and approval records.

- Track TOP samples and other production-stage submissions as needed.

- Support the maintenance of accurate product, material, sample status, and development

information within WFX PLM, including library optimization, naming standardization,

duplicate cleanup, and data accuracy audits.

- Provide general administrative support, seasonal and office organization, and cross-

functional follow-up for Design, Product Development, and Technical Design.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Fashion Design, Product Development,

Merchandising, Textiles, or a related field.

- 0–2 years of relevant internship, assistant, or entry-level experience within fashion,

apparel, or product development.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, samples, and priorities in a fast-paced environment

where priorities may shift quickly.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of assigned tasks from start to

finish.

- Strong interest in fashion design, product development, and garment construction and

fit.

- Basic understanding of fabrics, trims, garment construction, color, and apparel

development preferred.

- Experience with or willingness to learn WFX or another PLM system.

- Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Miro, Microsoft Office, and/or Google

Workspace is a plus.

- Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and comfortable working across Design, Product

Development, Technical Design, Production, and Operations.

- Able to work in the office five days a week.

**Equal Opportunity**

SYRN is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive

team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. * Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.

* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)

* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make-ready and work orders are completed)

**Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Certified Apartment Manager (CAM) or Accredited Resident Manager (ARM) preferred.
* Ability to understand and perform all on-site software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Head Coach & Community Manager - Mission Bay
new_jobs.description:
[solidcore] is looking for a Head Coach who is passionate about sharing the [solidcore] brand and workout. Reporting to the Area Manager, the Head Coach is responsible for various tasks that will not only support the Studio and its success, but also support [solidcore] as a company in our mission to be the fastest growing and most successful boutique fitness studio. The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of eleven (11) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in-studio throughout new coach trainings.

### **You will be responsible for:**

* Serving as the [solidcore] studio’s lead coach, maintaining a full schedule of 11 classes per week.
* Serving as an example and setting the expectations for new and existing coaches.
* Delivering a best-in-class fitness and customer service experience consistent with [solidcore] standards.
* Meeting company utilization & retention expectations on both an individual level and for the studio as a whole.
* Taking direction from the Area Manager to assist with day-to-day operations of the studio.
* Lead outreach and marketing efforts as necessary to scout new clients and create long-term partnerships in the community.
* Providing coach development to a team of coaches, delivering informal/formal feedback & assisting new coach trainings with in-person support.
* Assisting as needed with responses to client requests and resolving concerns promptly and effectively.
* Maintaining product knowledge for all studio retail operations, including class packages, current promotions, and apparel.
* Executing routine operational tasks including, but not limited to ordering supplies, conducting inventory, and maintaining sales logs.
* Ensuring the studio and equipment remain impeccable and fully-functioning at all times.
* Other duties and projects as assigned and as needed.

### **What we need from you:**

* This is a permanent, exempt, full-time position with an expected 40 hours per week (including classes coached).
* Flexible and variable availability including weekends & holidays with ability to accommodate coach training schedules & the fluctuating needs of the business.
* Ability to lift / carry a minimum of 30 pounds.
* Proficiency in g-Suite and MS office, specifically excel and google sheets.

### **What skills and experience you will bring to us:**

* Optimism and hard work with a love for health, fitness, and the [solidcore] workout.
* Passionate about helping others become the strongest version of themselves and achieve their goals.
* Passionate about building relationships and developing teams, creating an environment that fosters growth.

new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Club Athletic is a premium members' training club with locations across New York City, Chicago and Hoboken. Our members train in squads: small, consistent groups that show up for each other. We're growing fast, and our social channels are where people first meet the club.

**About the Role**  
You'll run our Instagram and TikTok day to day, so they feel alive, consistent and true to the club. Our Director of Marketing sets the monthly editorial calendar. Our in-house content producer, coaches and members supply the photos and video. Your job is to turn that into a steady, on-brand presence and a community that feels looked after.

* **Publish:** write captions and schedule feed posts and reels across our main and Chicago accounts, following the monthly calendar

**When You'll Work**

* About 4 hours a day on weekdays and about 2 hours a day on weekends, to keep coverage consistent 7 days a week

This role is remote, but we'll prioritize candidates based in Chicago, Miami, San Francisco or Boston. If you're local to one of our current or upcoming markets, you may occasionally capture content in person at events or clubs.

* 2+ years managing social for a brand, ideally in fitness, wellness, hospitality or lifestyle

* Sharp, concise writing, and the ability to match an established brand voice
* A native feel for Instagram and TikTok formats, trends and community norms
* Experience with a scheduling tool
* Reliable, organized habits. You don't miss a day.
* Bonus: experience turning social conversations into leads or bookings

**What We Offer**

* $28–32/hour, depending on experience

* A creative, ambitious team building something members really care about

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Revenue Vessel is a growing, venture backed software company on a mission to revolutionize how logistics companies sell. We've built a product that our customers love, and are looking for help to grow significantly over the next 12 months. Our cold outreach motion is really working and we have already promoted, or will promote, all of our SDRs that we have hired. We need to hire the next generation of account executives and account managers, which starts with the SDR position.

Revenue Vessel is building out a new sales solution for logistics and has ambitions to be the key sales operating system across the industry. Our solution helps our customers better target and reach out to prospects that fit their services. We view our SDRs as future leaders, especially because they understand the challenges that our customers face when reaching out to prospects for new business.

Despite being less than three years old, we have signed annual contracts with fifteen out of the top twenty-five freight forwarders in our space and are looking to rapidly expand adoption and product surface area within our key accounts.

The three co-founders have strong backgrounds in the space: former Head of Demand Gen at Flexport, former top-performing sales leader at Flexport, former Head of Eng at Rutter API, respectively. Revenue Vessel is a solution built off the pain points and solutions the founders solved at Flexport.

Both our CEO and COO were former SDR leaders and are experienced in building the systems and career pathing that is required. We can promise rapid career progression - all of our former SDRs have been promoted or will be promoted in less than six months to Account Executive or Account Management roles. While we cannot promise growth at the same exact rate, we are growing rapidly and have new responsibilities to grow into every day!

Our customers are sellers who are used to picking up the phone and will respond at above-average connect rates. Every SDR we have hired has been able to set 15+ qualified, held meetings each month. It's time for us to dump gas on the fire!

This could be a billion dollar business, and we don't need to compete with other Silicon Valley founders in order to get there. We just need your help to pull it off.

**Role Overview**

You will be working directly with our CEO and AE to generate pipeline for Revenue Vessel. This will involve deep account research and a healthy dose of cold calls as well. You will be given freedom to be creative with your outreach, come up with new sequences, and even experiment with new tools if they have strong ROI. As an early member of the team, you will be a key part in designing our GTM strategy and will have a ton of opportunity for career growth as you generate results.

**Responsibilities**

* Generate qualified leads through outbound prospecting activities including cold calling, email outreach, and social selling
* Research and identify target prospects within assigned market segments and territories
* Qualify inbound leads and marketing-generated inquiries to determine fit and buying intent
* Schedule qualified meetings and demos for Account Executives
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information in CRM system
* Meet or exceed monthly quotas for qualified opportunities and meetings set
* Collaborate closely with marketing and sales teams to optimize lead generation strategies
* Follow up persistently with prospects while maintaining professional relationships

**You will LOVE this job if:**

* You want to work closely with smart, high integrity, personal growth-oriented co-workers.
* You enjoy working independently and quickly on things.
* You have no fear of hammering the phones and reaching out to new stakeholders.
* You have a commercial mindset that can be applied at all levels - senior and middle management and individual contributors.
* You have strong written communication and presentation skills, with both senior internal and external stakeholders.
* You love being in the thick of it all, understanding the whole workings of a startup, and building a plane as we fall from the sky.

**This job is NOT for you if:**

* You want the immediate cushy and chill life that a large, stable tech company provides.
* You find yourself excelling in highly-structured, hoop-jumping cultures.
* You are worried about taking on personal risk.

**In order to excel here, you will need to:**

* Be the type of person who never shies away from a problem just because you haven't done it before.
* Learn quickly and teach yourself new concepts as needed.
* Travel on average once per month.

**Company Values**

The company values these things. If you're excited about this, we're excited about you. If these aren't you, then we're probably not the right place.

* Brutal focus: We do one thing at a time, and we do it extremely well. Right now, we're building sales tools for logistics companies. We say no to everything else, even if someone was waving a $1M check in front of our eyes.
* Too high integrity: We believe that integrity in business is incredibly important. We'd happily lose some money if it meant doing right by a customer or prospect.
* Improve and Get Better Every Day: We believe in making the business and ourselves 1% better every day. As we make more money, we plan to re-invest most of it in improving our existing team as well as our processes. We give and take kind, candid feedback, and we're always looking for ways to become better.
* You want to build a money printing machine: We believe that at the end of the day, the only thing that matters is cash in vs cash out.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid office setup in San Francisco.
* Generous equity (we want you to feel so invested in the company's success that you make away like a bandit)
* Competitive cash comp and uncapped quota.
* For US employees, 100% fully-paid-for top-tier health insurance, dental, and (optional) life insurance

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help Global Financial Services customers across capital markets insurance and banking and payments gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute Storage Database Big Data Application-level services Networking Serverless and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to some of the world's largest financial services organizations.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2 S3 DynamoDB & RDS databases Lambda CloudFront CDN IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs regulatory requirements support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy through application-specific reviews proactive monitoring and custom runbooks. You will use generative AI tools fluently in your own work to accelerate troubleshooting operational reviews and customer insights and guide customers on adopting AWS generative AI services to modernize and streamline their operations. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
* Work proactively as part of the AWS Unified Operations (UOps) delivery model to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2 S3 DynamoDB & RDS databases Lambda CloudFront CDN IoT and many more.
* Effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment leveraging your technical acumen and customer-facing skills.
* Drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs regulatory requirements support and risk management.
* Proactively keep customers' AWS environments operationally healthy through application-specific reviews proactive monitoring and custom runbooks.
* Use generative AI tools fluently to accelerate troubleshooting operational reviews and customer guidance and help customers adopt AWS generative AI services to modernize their operations.

  
About the team  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems enviro

Atmosphere is the leading streaming TV platform built specifically for businesses. Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming waiting rooms, gyms, bars, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 150 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

Atmosphere is seeking an ambitious, growth-minded Manager to support the National Advertising Sales Team while leading and developing a team of NYC-based National Account Managers. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people management with individual contributor responsibilities, including direct ownership of campaign planning, processing, execution, reporting, and billing.

The Manager will coach and develop the team, provide workload and process support, and drive consistency and excellence across the National Account Management function. The ideal candidate is an experienced advertising or media professional who is highly organized, adept at quickly shifting priorities, technologically savvy, and passionate about developing talent, with a remarkably positive and collaborative attitude.

This is a hybrid role with in-office presence at our NYC office. This position will report to the Director, Account Management.

**What you'll do**

***Leadership & Mentorship***

* Directly manage and mentor a team of NYC-based National Account Managers, providing day-to-day guidance, support, and professional development.
* Establish and model best practices for campaign management, client communication, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance check-ins, and coaching sessions to support each team member’s growth and success.
* Onboard and train new Account Managers, ensuring they are set up for success with the tools, processes, and knowledge needed to thrive.
* Foster a high-performance team culture rooted in accountability, positivity, and client-first thinking.

***Campaign & Client Management***

* Provide pre-sales support, compiling sales data and building out media plans for key prospects and sales opportunities.
* Build and manage campaigns for the National Ad Sales team.

* Collaborate with the internal accounting team to manage client billing.
* Work closely with remote colleagues on a daily basis.
* Nurture client relationships and embrace the mission to create an Army of Client Advocates.
* Dedicated to establishing a new industry standard for client care and interaction.
* Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of Atmosphere’s products, programs, partnerships, and editorial slate.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Advertising, Media Studies, or related field preferred.
* 5+ years of related experience in account management or client services within the advertising/media industry, including at least 1–2 years in a team lead, supervisory, or mentorship capacity.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and inspire team members in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of online advertising, strategy, and analytics.
* Enthusiastic about advancing their career and expanding their expertise in Advertising Sales.
* Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite.
* Experience with Salesforce, Asana, and Adobe products are a plus!
* Detail-oriented, well-organized, flexible, and highly motivated.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Commitment to a high quality of work and excellent client services.
* Ability to work effectively with different personalities, thriving in both home and office environments.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Base salary range $110,000 - $120,000 + Commission\*
* Company Equity
* Company 401(k) with employer matching
* Competitive insurance plans
* Flexible Time Off Policy
* *Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skills, experience, and qualification for the role.*

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  
  
We’re looking for a results oriented Sales Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As a Sales Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. You’ll not only dive deep into data to understand trends, but also communicate the “why” behind results and make actionable recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Sales, Product, and Retail partners and will drive process improvement to gain efficiency and foster collaboration. The Sales Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise and influence is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions with revenue experience
* Develop annual brand and media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals/objectives
* Develop omnichannel media plans, campaign strategies, and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data driven approach
* Perform in-depth data analysis to deliver actionable insights & recommendations that influence short term / long term digital media strategy
* Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to achieve greater results on Amazon
* Work cross-functionally with sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction

  
About the team  
LCSA is a video-first team focused on activating new-to-Amazon customers. LCSA AMs are responsible for customer retention through 1P/3P insights, client education, and strategic product expansion.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

- - 2+ years of client facing Advertising and/or Sales role with revenue ownership.  
- - Experience in Omni-channel marketing, display, over-the-top (OTT), or search marketing  
- - Effectively analyze data and insights to present strategic and tactical plans to advertisers  
- - Adept at solving problems that span business and technology  
- - Influence process improvement that scales broadly; inventing and simplifying within existing processes

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

- - 3-5 years work experience in Advertising with experience owning Media Buying/Planning across Digital Advertising, eCommerce, and/or Linear Broadcast/Streaming TV focused roles.  
- - Bachelors’ degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering or Business; MBA is a plus  
- - Excellent organizational, relationship-building, and communication (written and verbal) skills  
- - Programmatic strategy and implementation experience  
- - Proven track record of delivering results (including revenue targets) and significantly contributing to advertiser revenue growth  
  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  
USA, NY, New York - 66,300.00 - 108,800.00 USD annually

new_jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about, helping grow businesses and the communities that support them. To further this mission, we're looking for an experienced paid media operator to join our Consumer Marketing team at a pivotal time for DoorDash Ads and paid co-marketing.

The Cx Ads Paid team plans, launches and measures paid media campaigns with brand and CPG partners, working alongside Ads Integrated Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and our agency partners. The team is growing, and this person will help shape how paid marketing operates as it scales.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a strategic, decisive paid marketing leader to own Co-Marketing Paid Media strategy and operations in the US as it pertains to supporting Co-Marketing Merchant priorities. This role will support +20 strategic campaigns across $XXM covering CPG, Restaurant, and New Vertical industries. You will set the operating model, make the decisions that keep the campaign on track against launch timing, ROAS performance, and advertisers commitments. You will be the voice of Paid in cross-functional forums, arriving with data, a clear point of view and a recommendation, and you will lead agency and platform partners as the single accountable owner. This is your opportunity to influence and own a Paid marketing function as a lead, touching channel decision making and strategy with Director + visibility.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the end to end paid marketing operations, from intake and planning through launch, in-flight management and recap
* Make independent decisions on campaign operations and bring a clear recommendation to cross-functional discussion: For example channel mix, creative, and optimization strategies.
* Problem Solving: When there are unknowns, be the central driver to align on things like budgets, partnership commitments, and required approvals
* Lead agencies and platform partners such as our Media Agency, Meta and The Trade Desk, from brief to delivery
* Drive strategic projects end to end, including building channel playbooks, process revamps and the test-and-learn agenda
* Lead and develop a team of 2 (with opportunity to scale), delegating ownership of processes and planning capacity against the campaign calendar
* Must have experience interacting with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
* Leadership Communication Opportunity: Keep leadership and partners informed with proactive updates, early risk flags and escalations that come with a proposed solution
* Deliver recap reports and performance readouts with a clear narrative and benchmarks, ready for Marketing and Sales review

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

You're a decisive, results-oriented marketer who has led paid media programs and XFN teams. You form a point of view from data, act on it, and keep the right people informed along the way. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, delegating work you should not be doing yourself, and holding partners to a high bar. You have experience managing leadership and can write and speak concisely to such an audience

* 5-8 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, campaign management or marketing operations
* Experience managing agencies and paid channels such as CTV/OLV, programmatic, paid social, and DOOH
* Strong command of campaign measurement, including ROAS, benchmarking and root cause analysis of performance
* Track record of owning cross-functional projects and decisions without direct authority
* Sound judgment on when to decide, when to align and when to escalate
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with examples of leadership-ready updates and recommendations
* Experience building and scaling processes, trackers and playbooks
* [Preferred] Experience in CPG, QSR or marketplace co-marketing, and with tools such as Sigma, iSpot or Monday.com

**Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash**
---------------------------------------

* We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do* - on every project, every day.
* We are learning - We're not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it's scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute.
* We are customer obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
* We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.
* We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

We expect this position to be filled by 07/12/2026

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspective

**Build and own logistics at Planture US.** Planture is looking for a hands-on Logistics Coordinator to take ownership of logistics for our US office. You’ll be the first person in this role, with the opportunity to shape how the function works and build a strong domestic logistics network as our business grows and have close connections with our HQ office in Amsterdam.

This is a role for someone who enjoys keeping shipments moving, staying on top of contracts and schedules, and stepping in when plans change. Logistics can be unpredictable, so you’ll need to be comfortable solving problems quickly while keeping customers and colleagues informed.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate imports through our customer broker, including customs clearance, drayage and delivery to external warehouses.
* Coordinate outbound shipments from our warehouses to customers.
* Organize, monitor and administratively process import orders.
* Track delivery schedules, transport status and logistics positions, and act quickly when something is delayed or at risk.
* Manage logistics contracts and service agreements, keeping terms, rates and performance under review.
* Stay in regular contact with brokers, carriers, warehouses, logistics department in Amsterdam and other logistics partners.
* Request, compare and negotiate transportation rates and service agreements.
* Act as the link between logistics partners, customers and Planture’s commercial team.
* Help the commercial team provide customers with clear, timely updates and practical solutions.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve logistics processes and systems.
* Build and develop Planture’s network of domestic logistics partners.

**What we’re looking for**

You’re an independent and organized logistics professional who takes ownership and enjoys making things work. You can keep track of the details while also seeing where a process can be improved. When a shipment runs into trouble, you stay calm, communicate clearly and focus on the next steps.

**You’ll bring:**

* Around two years of relevant logistics experience.
* Experience with international logistics and order fulfilment.
* Knowledge of customs clearance and import procedures; experience with US imports is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills and close attention to detail.
* A structured, accurate and well-organized way of working.
* Clear communication skills and confidence dealing with customers and external partners.
* A commercial, solution-focused mindset.
* The ability to work independently, set priorities and take ownership.
* Availability to work five days per week.

**What we offer:**

* The opportunity to take ownership of logistics at Planture US and build the function as it grows.
* A broad, hands-on role with direct involvement in logistics decisions, partner relationships, customer support and process improvements.
* Close collaboration with Planture’s commercial team and logistics partners.
* Salary between $40.000 - $80.000 depending on relevant experience

**Why join Planture?**

You’ll have a direct impact on Planture’s day-to-day logistics operations. You won’t just process orders: you’ll help shape transportation decisions, manage logistics partners and contracts, support customers and improve the way logistics works across the US business.

If you’re ready to take responsibility, solve real-world logistics challenges and build something from the ground up, we’d like to hear from you.

The Festival is seeking a full-time Finance and Administrative Coordinator to join our mission-driven, collaborative team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, resourceful, and proactive administrator who enjoys working across functions and wants to play an important role in the day-to-day operations of a dynamic nonprofit arts organization.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Financial and Administrative Officer, this position helps ensure that financial processes are accurate and timely, leadership and board activities are well coordinated, and the Festival’s office operates smoothly and efficiently. The Finance and Administrative Coordinator will join a team of 17 year-round staff members dedicated to enriching lives through the power of music.
  
  
In this small and highly collaborative organization, the Coordinator will work closely with Festival leadership and staff while gaining broad experience across finance, nonprofit administration, governance, and operations. The successful candidate will be someone who can manage details carefully, anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and shift comfortably among financial, administrative, operational, and technology-related responsibilities.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Events & Communications Specialist serves as a key member of the Development Team and plays a central role in coordinating fundraising events, implementing communications strategies, and managing a variety of development projects and administrative functions.

This position is responsible for coordinating special events and donor engagement opportunities, executing communications across digital platforms, maintaining development materials and ensuring the successful implementation of development initiatives. The Events & Communications Specialist works closely with the Executive Director, the Development Director, the Development Operations & Donor Relations Manager, the Grants, Institutional Giving & Impact Manager, and the Strategic Communications Consultant to support the organization's fundraising, stewardship, communications, and engagement goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with strong project management skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Events Management & Engagement**

* Coordinate and execute fundraising, stewardship, volunteer, and community engagement events, including Friendsfest, board-hosted events, cultivation gatherings, volunteer activities, and other organizational events.

* Coordinate event registration, guest management, volunteer recruitment, vendor relationships, venue logistics, catering, transportation, supplies, and event materials.

**Communications Implementation & Digital Channels**

* Implement communications plans developed by organizational leadership and communications partners.

* Assist with maintenance of development procedures, documentation, and organizational systems.

* Participate in cross-functional development initiatives and departmental planning.
* Contribute to the development of operational procedures, process documentation, and best practices.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2-4 years of experience in event management, communications, nonprofit development, marketing, project management, or a related field.
* Experience coordinating events, volunteer activities, or community engagement initiatives.
* Experience managing social media platforms, email marketing systems, websites, or digital communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, website management tools, email marketing platforms, and project management systems.

new_jobs.description:
***Nuva Haus*** *formerly Freeze & Float · River North, Chicago, IL*

***About Nuva Haus***

Nuva Haus is Chicago's destination for longevity and advanced wellness — a modern, considered space in River North where science-backed treatments meet genuine hospitality. We offer hormone optimization, peptide therapy, IV drips, aesthetics, and recovery modalities designed to help clients feel and perform at their best.

We're building a team that takes the client experience as seriously as the clinical one. That means every touchpoint — from the first call to the final follow-up — should feel intentional, warm, and exceptional.

***The Role***

This is a front-of-house role with real ownership. As our Client Experience & Wellness Concierge, you are the connective tissue of Nuva Haus — the person who makes clients feel known, supported, and excited to come back. You will work across every service line, build lasting relationships with our client base, and play a direct role in the growth and retention of the practice.

This is not a passive desk role. The right person is curious about wellness, energized by human connection, and brings a hospitality mindset to every interaction — whether that's greeting a new client, following up after a treatment, or helping someone understand which protocol is right for them.

***What You Will Own***

*Client Relationship & Retention*

* Greet every client with genuine warmth — remember names, preferences, and treatment history
* Drive rebooking and retention through personalized follow-up calls, texts, and progress check-ins
* Build long-term client relationships that support wellness goals and membership growth

*Clinic Coordination & Flow*

* Prepare guests for services including IV drips, injections, aesthetics, and recovery therapies
* Coordinate appointments and manage day-of scheduling with precision and calm
* Support room turnover, setup, and clinic cleanliness standards

*Client Education & Sales Support*

* Educate clients on our full service menu, wellness protocols, and membership offerings (full training provided)
* Make thoughtful product and service recommendations aligned to each client's goals
* Contribute to a culture of excellence, continuous learning, and team performance

***Who You Are***

* You have a genuine enthusiasm for wellness, longevity, or health optimization — and you bring that energy to every conversation
* You are warm, professional, and instinctively hospitable — clients leave your interactions feeling taken care of
* You are organized, reliable, and calm under pressure in a fast-moving clinical environment
* You can hold a real conversation about treatments like NAD+, IV therapy, peptide protocols, and aesthetics — or you're highly motivated to learn
* Experience in wellness, medspa, aesthetics, hospitality, or client services is a strong advantage — not a requirement
* A licensed esthetician or medical assistant background is a plus, not a prerequisite

*We will train the right person. What we can't train is genuine care, professional presence, and the instinct to make every client feel like a priority.*

***Compensation & Benefits***

* **Pay:** $21–$30 per hour, based on experience
* **Bonus:** Commission structure and client retention bonuses available
* **Discounts:** Generous staff discounts on services and wellness products
* **Schedule:** Full-time and part-time available · Weekend rotation required
* **Training:** Ongoing access to cutting-edge treatments and professional development
* **Environment:** Beautiful, modern wellness space in River North with a supportive, growth-oriented team
* **Health Insurance:** Explored at the 6-month milestone for eligible team members

***How to Apply***

Send your resume and a brief note — not a form cover letter — to jobs@nuvahaus.com. Tell us: what draws you to the intersection of wellness and client experience, and what kind of impression you want to leave on the people you work with every day.

LinkedIn profiles welcome. We read everything we receive.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* On-the-job training

Work Location: In person

This is not a housekeeping role. We are looking for someone who can become the organizational center of our lives — helping us manage schedules, travel, social commitments, personal projects and several new business ventures while making everything run more smoothly and efficiently.

The ideal person is someone who genuinely loves organization, thinks ahead, solves problems quickly and enjoys creating systems that make busy lives easier.

* Managing calendars, appointments and daily schedules
* Coordinating flights, hotels, transportation and travel itineraries
* Organizing social plans, dinners, events and reservations

* Managing personal appointments and reminders
* Helping organize our weeks so our time is used more effectively
* Creating and maintaining to-do lists, project trackers and follow-up systems
* Coordinating our cleaning lady and other service providers
* Managing deliveries, packages, returns and occasional errands
